job.title: Support & Services Business Development Manager
job.description:
What you can expect


We are looking for a Services Growth Manager to drive the growth of Zoom's Technical Support and Managed Services portfolio. You will identify opportunities across existing and prospective customers. Positioning Premier Support, Managed Services, and partner-led solutions to meet customer needs and drive revenue growth. By translating technical capabilities into business value, you'll help customers maximize their investment in Zoom. This role is ideal for someone with a background in Account Management, Customer Success, or Business Development. Someone who is passionate about building relationships and driving service adoption.

This role will be based in our London office in a hybrid capacity.


About the Team


Our team sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Service Delivery. We focus on delivering service experiences that help customers unlock the full value of Zoom’s platform. We collaborate globally to develop, position, and scale support and managed service offerings across diverse markets. We work closely with customers, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to bring impactful service solutions to market.We value customer empathy, commercial thinking, innovation, and collaboration. This enables us to drive meaningful business outcomes and long-term customer success.


Responsibilities


  • Owning regional growth strategies for Premier Support and Managed Services across EMEA and APAC, identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts and new customer segments.
  • Leveraging customer relationship management expertise to position services as a natural extension of the customer lifecycle, driving upsell, cross-sell, and revenue growth.
  • Building and scaling partner-led support models through partner onboarding, enablement, and joint service development initiatives.
  • Leading go-to-market execution in collaboration with regional sales teams, including co-selling activities, customer discovery, business case development, and revenue acceleration.
  • Shaping service offerings by partnering with Product Management on packaging, pricing strategies, and roadmap alignment while representing customer needs and market requirements.
  • Tracking key performance indicators and leveraging data-driven insights to optimise pipeline performance, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes.
  • Collaborating with Sales, Product, Service Delivery, Marketing, Legal, IT, and partner organisations to ensure seamless execution and regional compliance.

What we’re looking for


  • Have 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Business Development, or similar customer-facing roles within SaaS, UCaaS, cloud, or technology environments.
  • Bring a proven track record of growing customer relationships and delivering measurable revenue outcomes through upselling, cross-selling, renewals, or new business acquisition.
  • Have experience positioning and selling services, solutions, support offerings, or value-added products beyond core software licensing.
  • Demonstrate the ability to navigate complex, matrixed organisations and manage multi-stakeholder sales and decision-making processes.
  • Bring commercial acumen and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise customers.
  • Have experience working with channel partners, telecommunications providers, carriers, resellers, or global systems integrators across EMEA and/or APAC markets.
  • Bring knowledge of go-to-market strategy, service lifecycle management, partner program development, or services-led growth initiatives.
  • Demonstrate analytical capabilities, using performance metrics and pipeline data to drive informed business decisions.

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.

Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.


Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Tech Support Engineer at Zoom, you will serve as a primary point of contact for end-users and business customers, delivering timely technical assistance across Zoom's full product suite. You will develop hands-on expertise in SIP/VoIP and Contact Center technologies while building the diagnostic and problem-solving skills that form the foundation of a strong technical support career. Working across global shifts and multiple communication channels, you will make a direct impact on customer satisfaction through clear communication, disciplined follow-through, and genuine care for resolution quality. This role involves shift rotation across APAC, EMEA, and US Eastern time zones to support our global customer base. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our Bangalore, India office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Our Customer Support team is a global, customer-first organization committed to delivering exceptional experiences across Zoom's complete product portfolio. We combine technical depth with genuine empathy, working collaboratively across time zones to resolve issues efficiently and build lasting trust with every customer we serve. We invest in our people through continuous learning, product training, and a culture where curiosity and improvement are always encouraged.


Responsibilities

•Respond to customer inquiries across Zoom products via chat, email, and phone with professionalism and urgency

•Diagnose and resolve issues related to voice communication systems, call routing, and Contact Center applications

•Document customer interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions accurately within the ticketing system, ensuring proper follow-up and closure

•Deliver clear, step-by-step technical guidance using internal knowledge bases, diagnostic tools, and support resources

•Collaborate with Level 2 and Level 3 support teams to escalate and resolve complex technical issues effectively

•Participate in on-call rotation, including weekend coverage, and shift work across APAC, EMEA, and US Eastern time zones

•Attend product training sessions and team meetings to stay current on Zoom product updates, new features, and support policies

•Maintain high standards of professionalism, empathy, and customer satisfaction in every interaction


What We're Looking For

•2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in a technical support role

•Working knowledge of SIP/VoIP technologies, protocols, and telephony concepts including call flow mechanisms

•Practical understanding of Contact Center platforms and support operations

•Basic technical knowledge of audio/video devices, internet and network troubleshooting, and SaaS applications

•Proficiency with support tools such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent platforms

•Familiarity with network diagnostic tools such as ping, traceroute, Wireshark, or tcpdump

•Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-focused approach, composure under pressure, and strong time management in a fast-paced, shift-based environment

job.title: Product Manager, Zoom Phone
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you'll shape the direction of cloud telephony features as part of the Zoom Phone product team, owning objectives and KPIs that directly influence how millions of people communicate at work. You'll work at the intersection of customer insight, data, and cross-functional execution, translating complex telephony requirements into reliable, user-centered product experiences. This is a role for someone curious about how enterprise communication evolves and energized by delivering scalable solutions in a fast-moving environment. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are also available for this role.


About the Team

The Zoom Phone team leads the development and evolution of Zoom's cloud-based phone services, defining product strategies that deliver scalable, reliable, and user-friendly communication solutions for enterprise customers worldwide. We partner closely with engineering, design, sales, and support to ensure Zoom Phone integrates seamlessly within Zoom Workplace, continuously raising the bar for the telephony experience.


Responsibilities

  • Define and prioritize product features and enhancements for Zoom Phone, grounded in customer insight and strategic business value.
  • Translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, business requirements, and functional specifications for core telephony systems and services.
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, partnering with engineering and design to drive iterative, agile delivery.
  • Partner with product managers, product marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to define and evolve the core telephony platform roadmap.
  • Analyze product KPIs and usage data to surface trends, validate requirements, and drive improvements that increase customer satisfaction.
  • Evaluate competitive and adjacent products, track industry trends, and engage directly with customers and stakeholders to sharpen product direction.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of product management experience focused on telephony solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence across teams, simplify complex ideas, and drive clear decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Proven success in telephony-centric businesses, including enterprise SaaS, communication, and collaboration products, with the ability to deliver innovative solutions in dynamic environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud and on-premise enterprise unified communications platforms, with a track record of translating technical complexity into compelling product experiences.
  • Familiarity with telephony protocols including SIP signaling, RTP, WebRTC, and H.323, as well as hardware such as PBX systems and IP phones.
  • Working knowledge of network quality factors, including QoS, latency, jitter, and packet loss, and their impact on call quality.
  • Experience integrating telephony services via RESTful APIs and managing product delivery using Agile and scrum methodologies.

$98,900.00 - $228,700.00

job.title: Premier Support Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


Lead a team of Technical Account Managers at the center of Zoom's most strategic enterprise relationships, directly shaping customer outcomes and the long-term health of the Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will develop your team, define performance goals, and serve as an executive escalation point for complex customer situations, working closely with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This is a role for someone who leads with data, builds accountability with genuine care, and is committed to developing people alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within the Global Premier Support organization. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team


The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realize the full value of Zoom Workplace. Working at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, the team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a core part of Zoom's customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM organization, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Own executive-level escalation for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support retention and growth across the Premier portfolio.
  • Identify underperformance within the team and manage structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that strengthen team processes and the Premier Services program.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams in a customer-facing organization, with a track record of developing high-performing talent.
  • 5+ years of experience in the SaaS industry and/or Unified Communications space, with deep familiarity with enterprise collaboration environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence executive-level stakeholders, including delivering compelling presentations and driving strategic alignment.
  • Proven track record of executing strategy at operational and organizational scale, using data and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to deliver measurable improvements in team efficiency and service delivery.
  • Familiarity with Unified Communications technologies such as Zoom Workplace, Cisco, Microsoft, or equivalent platforms; knowledge of IP telephony, SIP, or API/SDK integration is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Account Executive - Midmarket VAST
job.description:
Account Executive, Midmarket


What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own a defined East or Central U.S. territory and drive growth across both new and existing Midmarket accounts by selling the full Zoom Workplace platform. You will engage with senior decision-makers to understand their communication challenges and connect them to solutions that genuinely move their business forward. This is a high-activity, relationship-driven role where your ability to build trust, uncover opportunity, and close complex deals creates direct impact. You will develop your consultative sales craft within a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and customer outcomes.


About the Team

Our VAST (Value Added Selling Team) MassMarket Sales team is a driven, collaborative group focused on growing Zoom’s presence within the Midmarket segment across a defined geographic territory. We work closely with customers and internal partners alike to ensure every engagement delivers measurable value. Our team’s mission is to help growing organizations unlock the full potential of Zoom Workplace.


Responsibilities

  • Engage existing customers to maximize the value of their Zoom Workplace investments and identify expansion opportunities within the account base.
  • Prospect and develop a high-volume pipeline of new Midmarket opportunities within an assigned geographic territory.
  • Qualify inbound leads and actively source net-new opportunities, applying value-added selling techniques to upsell and grow revenue.
  • Create, deliver, and manage compelling demos, presentations, proposals, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) tailored to customer needs.
  • Build and maintain relationships with C-Level and VP-Level executives, positioning Zoom as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Identify prospect needs, qualify opportunities, and engage technical resources at the right stage to accelerate deals.
  • Manage quotes and proposals with accuracy and timeliness throughout the sales cycle.


What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrate 2+ years of Account Executive experience selling SaaS, UCaaS, or cloud-based solutions, or equivalent experience in a related field.
  • Apply proficiency with CRM tools to manage pipeline, track activity, and maintain accurate forecasting.
  • Communicate complex technical solutions clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bring a consultative, customer-first approach to every stage of the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

$92,300.00 - $184,600.00

job.title: Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Agentic Retrieval team. You will design and build the core retrieval and reasoning systems that power Zoom’s AI Companion — enabling AI agents to search, reason over, and act on enterprise knowledge to deliver high- quality, trustworthy, and actionable answers at scale.


About the Team

The Agentic Retrieval team sits within Zoom’s GenAI Engineering organization and is responsible for building a multi-tenant, permission-aware retrieval platform. We operate at the intersection of distributed systems, machine learning, and large language models — powering search and answer generation across meetings, chat, docs, and third-party enterprise applications through a layered API architecture (keyword search, natural language search, and agentic RAG-based answer generation).


Responsibilities:

  • Designing and implementing scalable retrieval systems including vector search, hybrid search (keyword + embedding + reranking), and structured query planning.
  • Designing and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for multi-step, tool-using AI agents.
  • Developing ranking, relevance modeling, and evaluation frameworks to improve search quality and answer grounding.
  • Building indexing pipelines that transform heterogeneous enterprise data into unified, retrieval-ready representation.
  • Building entity extraction and NLP pipelines that support agentic reasoning over enterprise content.
  • Partnering with product, infrastructure, and applied research teams to ship production- grade AI capabilities.

What we’re looking for

  • Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Distributed Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning, search infrastructure, information retrieval, or distributed systems
  • Strong hands-on experience building and operating large-scale search or data platforms in production environments.
  • Have experience building or integrating RAG systems and LLM-based applications in production.
  • Possess proficiency in one or more of: Python, Go, Java, C#, or C++.
  • Solid understanding of information retrieval fundamentals (inverted index, ranking,
    embeddings, hybrid retrieval).
  • Strong system design skills with the ability to reason about scale, reliability, latency, and cost trade-off.


Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$206,600.00 - $451,800.00


In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.


Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.


We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

job.title: Billing Support Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Billing Support Manager at Zoom, you will lead a global customer support team committed to delivering consistent, high-quality billing service across every customer segment. You will develop your team through coaching and structured performance management, while driving operational excellence through data analysis, cross-functional partnership, and continuous process improvement. This role reports to the Head of Billing Support and carries direct responsibility for frontline billing agents.

About the Team

The Customer Support and Billing team is a global organization delivering around-the-clock support to Zoom customers and partners, from small business to Premier Services. We are Zoom's Service Delivery Team, united by a commitment to resolving complex billing issues quickly and creating exceptional experiences for every customer we serve.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and enforce frontline billing agent schedules, work plans, and performance standards.
  • Lead agents in addressing customer billing inquiries across inbound/outbound phone, chat, and ticket channels.
  • Oversee customer escalation processes and complex issue resolution workflows to ensure timely, quality outcomes.
  • Implement standardized procedures for issue management and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Review escalated cases, identify handling gaps, and deliver regular operational readouts and improvement findings to senior and executive leadership.
  • Analyze support data and performance metrics to surface trends and track agent adherence to KPIs.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance to address agent process compliance gaps and close performance deficiencies.
  • Evaluate current workflows and implement targeted improvements to enhance operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in billing management, accounts receivable, or finance, ideally within a global organization.
  • Solid understanding of customer support metrics, coaching methodologies, and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience managing customer escalations and complex issue resolution, preferably in a contact center environment.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Familiarity with multi-platform workflows, including tools such as Zuora, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

job.title: Porting Escalation Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you're the senior escalation point when porting situations get complicated, and at Zoom, complicated means high-value customers, multi-stakeholder partner deployments, and scenarios where a calm, credible voice makes all the difference. You'll engage directly with Premier and Elite customers and certified Zoom partners, stepping in when first-line support has reached its limits and the situation calls for someone who can take ownership, communicate clearly, and drive resolution. Strong knowledge of local number portability is the foundation, but what matters most in this role is how you handle pressure: delivering difficult news with confidence, thinking ahead to prevent recurrence, and keeping every stakeholder informed along the way. Beyond individual escalations, you'll mentor the Porting Specialists around you and help build the processes and standards that make the whole team stronger.


About the Team

The Porting Support team is a core part of Zoom's Technical Support organization, focused on guiding customers and partners through number porting for Zoom Phone and Zoom Contact Center. We work closely with carriers, certified partners, PSO teams, and internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to keep deployments on track and customers connected. The majority of what we handle comes through partner-led and PSO-supported deployments, and we take pride in delivering a level of service that matches the scale and complexity of the customers we serve.


Responsibilities

  • Own complex, high-priority porting escalations from partners, PSO teams, and internal stakeholders, driving each to resolution with urgency and clear communication.
  • Triage and route escalation tickets to the appropriate team members, ensuring every issue reaches the right person at the right time.
  • Build and maintain strong carrier relationships to facilitate efficient port processing, resolve disputes, and address recurring issues before they become patterns.
  • Mentor and develop Porting Specialists through coaching, hands-on guidance, and knowledge-sharing that builds individual and team capability.
  • Communicate promptly and clearly with customers, partners, and internal teams, including when delivering difficult news or managing expectations in high-stakes, multi-stakeholder situations.
  • Partner with the Porting Support Manager on KPI tracking, reporting, and process improvements that strengthen how the team operates.
  • Lead and monitor large-scale projects from initiation through completion, ensuring progress, timelines, and deliverables stay on track, particularly during peak periods or when escalation volume is lower.
  • Create and maintain documentation, training materials, and standard operating procedures that keep the team aligned as porting challenges evolve.
  • Stay flexible and available for after-hours or on-call support when critical porting issues require immediate attention.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Support or Telecommunications, with at least 2 years focused on number porting or carrier operations; a relevant degree is welcomed, though equivalent experience is equally valued
  • Deep, working knowledge of number porting processes, including LNP (Local Number Portability), CSR (Customer Service Records), LOA (Letter of Authorization), and carrier provisioning workflows
  • Demonstrated ability to manage high-stakes escalations in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment, including confidence in delivering difficult news and staying composed across complex, multi-stakeholder situations
  • Strong carrier relationship management experience, with the ability to resolve disputes, negotiate outcomes, and address systemic issues before they escalate
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable information for customers, partners, and leadership
  • Experience mentoring or developing team members, with a genuine interest in building capability through knowledge-sharing and process improvement
  • Eligibility to access Zoom for Government (ZfG) and Zoom for Defense environments (US-based personnel required); familiarity with Zoom Phone, UCaaS, VoIP platforms, or ticketing systems such as ServiceNow is a plus

job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Head of Customer Success, APAC, you will lead regional CS operations across Asia-Pacific, owning revenue retention, product adoption, and customer satisfaction for a growing portfolio of customers and ARR. Reporting into our global Customer Success organization, you will build and develop a team of CS leaders and CSMs across multiple APAC markets, bridging regional execution with global strategy. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Renewals, CX Ops, and Product to drive measurable improvements to GRR and customer outcomes, bringing both strategic vision and executional discipline to the region.


About the Team

Customer Success at Zoom plays a central role in shaping the customer experience, building lasting relationships, driving product adoption, and ensuring customers realize measurable value from their investment in Zoom. We are strategic by design and cross-functional by nature, continuously improving how we engage customers across the full lifecycle. Our work directly impacts customer retention, growth, and satisfaction across a global and growing portfolio.


Responsibilities

  • Lead regional customer success operations across Asia-Pacific, driving revenue retention, product adoption, and customer satisfaction for a growing portfolio of customers and ARR.
  • Build, manage, and develop a high-performing team of CS leaders and CSMs across multiple APAC markets, fostering a culture of shared vision, accountability, and continuous improvement.

job.title: Global BPO Partner Business Development
job.description:
What You Can Expect


You will spearhead Zoom's entry into the global BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) market — a segment representing millions of contact center agents worldwide. Your mission: pursue and onboard the largest BPOs in the world, establishing Zoom as the most disruptive CX platform partner in the outsourcing industry. You will own the full pursuit lifecycle — from initial engagement through signed partnership — then hand off to the field for ongoing account management. This is a hunter role built for someone who thrives on opening doors, navigating complex organizations, and closing strategic partnerships that reshape how outsourced customer experiences are delivered.


About the Team


Our Channel GTM team collaborates across CX Product, Sales, Partner Programs, and Operations to build and scale new routes to market — and BPO is the next frontier. We've already invested in building a BPO Partner Program with tailored commercial models, certifications, volume licensing agreements, and partner/customer hybrid GTM motions. Now we need the right person to go land the partnerships.


Responsibilities

  • Identifying, pursuing, and closing BPO partnerships globally — the largest outsourcers operating millions of contact center seats across voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels
  • Owning the full business development lifecycle: prospecting, discovery, relationship building, negotiation, and partnership execution — then handing off onboarded partners to the field organization
  • Positioning Zoom's CX portfolio (Contact Center, Virtual Agent, Workforce Engagement Management) as the platform of choice for BPO operations, emphasizing differentiated models, scalability, and AI-powered capabilities
  • Navigating the unique needs of BPO partners — including flexible scaling, reporting, partner/customer hybrid GTM motions, outcome-based pricing, and certification requirements — that distinguish BPOs from traditional enterprise brands
  • Partnering cross-functionally with CX Product, Partner Programs, and Operations to shape BPO-specific offerings, ensure technical readiness, and drive seamless partner onboarding
  • Building and presenting compelling business cases to BPO executive leadership that demonstrate the ROI of migrating to or adopting Zoom's CX platform
  • Tracking pipeline, forecasting deal progression, and reporting on partnership development milestones to Channel and CX leadership
  • Collaborating with the Partner Programs team to refine BPO-specific program elements — pricing, certifications, volume licensing agreements, and enablement content — based on field feedback from active pursuits

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or channel sales within CCaaS, UCaaS, or contact center technology — with direct exposure to BPOs
  • Proven track record of sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships with large outsourcers, managed service providers, or similar partner ecosystems
  • Deep understanding of the BPO operating model — including how outsourcers evaluate, procure, and deploy contact center platforms at scale across geographies and clients
  • Experience navigating commercial negotiations involving volume licensing, outcome-based pricing, multi-tenant requirements, and partner/customer hybrid go-to-market structures
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build C-level relationships at global BPO organizations and articulate Zoom's CX value proposition in their language
  • Familiarity with Zoom's CX portfolio (Contact Center, Virtual Agent, Workforce Engagement Management, Quality Management) or equivalent competitive platforms
  • Self-starter mentality — comfortable operating in a net-new market with no existing quota baseline, measured initially on MBO-driven milestones rather than traditional quota attainment
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — able to work across Product, Engineering, Partner Programs, and Field Sales to translate BPO requirements into actionable partner solutions

$167,300.00 - $366,100.00

job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What You Can Expect

While on Zoom's Tier 2 Technical Support team, you'll provide elevated technical support and assistance to Zoom's commercial and consumer customers. As a Zoom Technical Support Engineer, you'll ensure our customers' success with Zoom products and services, and deliver happiness with every customer engagement. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Denver, CO office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Technical Support Engineering team plays a crucial role in improving the customer experience within Zoom. We build internal and external relationships, resolve technical issues, and act as dedicated technical support for customers. We provide our customers with technical guidance and resources to successfully utilize our solutions, effectively manage internal processes and procedures, actively collaborate with other internal teams and departments, and quickly adapt to changes with our rapidly growing product suite.


Responsibilities

  • Own and resolve inbound support cases and calls within our Tier 2 integrations domain, including API troubleshooting, calendar sync issues, and data mismatches across connected platforms.
  • Meet individual goals and metrics that drive organizational success, including case volume, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores.
  • Communicate promptly and consistently with customers, prioritizing urgent requests and maintaining timely follow-ups with customers, team members, and engineers.

  • Technical expertise with REST APIs, including hands-on familiarity reading payloads and tracing calls using tools like Postman or SOAP UI, and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Experience with Identity Management support, such as Okta SSO, Google SSO, or SCIM Provisioning.

job.title: Senior Manager, SEO & AI Search
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own how Workvivo shows up across organic search, AI answer engines, and peer review platforms, and connect that visibility directly to pipeline growth across four global regions. You will set the strategy, then execute much of it yourself: technical SEO audits, content briefs, measurement frameworks, and partnerships with web, product, and revenue teams that make the plan real. Your success is measured in organic and AI-referred pipeline, reported monthly to senior leadership, with regional share-of-voice targets guiding where to invest next. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Dublin, Ireland office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Workvivo growth marketing team runs demand generation, pipeline, and go-to-market programs across North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APJ. Working in close partnership with sales, product, and revenue operations, the team combines pace with clear accountability and plays a direct role in how Workvivo reaches and converts its market.


Responsibilities

  • Define the organic and AI search strategy for Workvivo across four global regions, establishing pipeline targets in partnership with leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Determine topic, buyer question, and competitive priorities by region, mapping search intent to the right pages and formats across the buyer journey.
  • Lead internationalisation of the Workvivo website, ensuring each regional market has the right language, local search intent, hreflang configuration, and page coverage rather than a translated copy of the US site.
  • Own the measurement model for organic and AI-referred traffic, tracking how visits convert to opportunities and delivering monthly pipeline reports to leadership.
  • Run technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, site speed, structured data, and international setup; specify fixes and partner with web and engineering teams to ship them.
  • Write or brief pages that answer buyer questions directly, including solution, comparison, and category pages, and edit content to a consistent brand voice.
  • Monitor Workvivo's presence in AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews; act on gaps through content, structured data, review platforms, and third-party coverage.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations, partner marketing, and communications to ensure organic and AI-referred leads are correctly scored and routed in HubSpot and Salesforce, and supported by the third-party mentions that search and AI tools draw on.

What We're Looking For

  • Five or more years in SEO or organic growth, with at least two years owning results for a B2B software business.
  • Hands-on technical SEO experience across crawl and indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and hreflang for multi-market sites.
  • A working understanding of how AI answer engines source and cite content, including an honest view of what can and cannot yet be measured.
  • Demonstrated experience connecting organic traffic to pipeline in HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Strong written English and a practiced eye for editing content to a brand voice.
  • Track record of presenting organic performance data clearly to senior leaders and adjusting strategy based on what the data shows.
  • Ability to operate across four regions and time zones; familiarity with EMEA markets, HR technology, or community-led and product-led brands is a plus.

job.title: Lead Technical SEO Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.


About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you are the primary driver of customer time-to-value, guiding a high-volume book of growth and commercial customers through structured onboarding from kickoff to launch. Each day, you'll lead configuration workshops, facilitate architecture discovery, and connect technical setup to each customer's real sales and marketing workflows. Your work directly shapes how quickly customers see results and how confidently they operate independently after go-live. You'll also serve as a key internal voice, surfacing patterns across implementations to strengthen the playbooks the whole team relies on. Candidates without hands-on CRM implementation experience (Salesforce and/or HubSpot) will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Our Implementation team sits at the intersection of customer success, technical delivery, and product insight, making sure every new customer reaches value on time and with confidence. We operate with a playbook-driven approach that balances consistency with the flexibility needed to meet each customer's unique GTM environment. Our work directly supports Zoom's growth by turning new customers into informed, self-sufficient users who advocate for the platform.


Responsibilities

  • Lead 15 or more concurrent implementations for growth and commercial customers, guiding each through programmatic onboarding frameworks from kickoff through launch

job.title: Technical Lead-Technical Support
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Technical Lead for our Technical Support Engineering team in Bangalore, you will serve as the primary escalation point, day-to-day technical mentor, and quality driver for a team resolving complex issues across Zoom Workplace, Zoom Phone, Zoom Contact Center, and enterprise integrations. You will guide engineers through difficult cases via real-time office hours and targeted coaching, build and maintain the team's knowledge foundation, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Security teams when customer issues require advanced investigation. Success in this role looks like stronger first-contact resolution, higher escalation quality, and customers who consistently feel heard and supported. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our Bangalore office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Technical Support Engineering team sits at the intersection of customer experience and deep technical expertise, resolving complex issues across Zoom's full product suite for enterprise customers around the world. Our work shapes customer satisfaction, product quality, and the reliability of Zoom Workplace as a global collaboration platform. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Account teams to close knowledge gaps, surface trends, and continuously raise the bar on the support experience.


Responsibilities

•Lead day-to-day technical escalation support for Technical Support Engineers, providing real-time troubleshooting guidance, case consultation, and technical decision-making direction through dedicated office hours and coaching channels.

•Review incoming escalations to confirm accurate issue framing, complete diagnostic collection, and appropriate troubleshooting direction before advancing cases to Engineering or senior review.

Support critical customer issues and priority incidents by coordinating triage, assessing impact, establishing resolution direction, and maintaining timely stakeholder communication throughout.

•Mentor and coach Technical Support Engineers on product knowledge, troubleshooting methodology, case ownership, customer communication, and escalation readiness.

•Deliver technical training, targeted knowledge-sharing sessions, and onboarding support based on recurring case trends, identified skill gaps, and team development needs.

•Build and maintain a comprehensive library of knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, SOPs, and decision trees covering common and complex support scenarios.

•Conduct structured case reviews and deliver specific, actionable feedback on troubleshooting quality, documentation accuracy, resolution correctness, and adherence to support processes.

•Identify recurring case trends, process gaps, and product issues; partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and Account teams on advanced investigations and recommend improvements to tools, automation, and workflows.


What We're Looking For

•8 to 12 years of experience in technical support, SaaS, or enterprise application support, with a demonstrated track record of providing technical leadership, escalation support, or mentoring within a support environment, or equivalent experience.

•Extensive hands-on expertise in SIP, VoIP, and Unified Communications environments, including SIP signaling, RTP media, SBCs, IP-PBX, codecs, NAT/firewall traversal, call routing, and quality analysis across enterprise UC and telephony platforms.

•Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, QoS, proxies) and proven ability to analyze network traffic, diagnose performance issues, and troubleshoot complex connectivity problems.

•Experience troubleshooting authentication and identity technologies (SSO, SAML, OAuth, SCIM, Active Directory) and familiarity with enterprise APIs, webhooks, contact center technologies, and third-party integrations.

•Ability to analyze logs, network traces, error messages, and diagnostic reports using support and diagnostic tools including ticketing systems, CRM platforms, log analysis utilities, and monitoring platforms.

•Demonstrated ability to create clear technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, runbooks, and escalation summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.

•Strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent case management discipline, and a customer-focused approach grounded in ownership, empathy, and timely follow-through in a fast-paced, global support environment.

job.title: Renewal Operations Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role is the operational backbone of Zoom’s Renewals function, responsible for transforming how the business forecasts, interprets, and acts on renewal and churn performance across a global, multi-geo post-sales organization. You will partner directly with Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Customer Success, and Renewals leadership to refine and scale an existing forecasting framework, surface leading indicators early, and build executive-ready insights that drive clear decisions and accountable outcomes.
This is a high-velocity environment where the expectation is to make an impact immediately: data ownership sits with partner teams, which means your ability to collaborate, influence without authority, and build trusted relationships is as important as your analytical depth. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office.


About the Team


The Retention Operations team is part of Zoom’s broader post-sales organization, which spans deployment, Customer Success, and Renewals across four global theaters, each led by geo-focused Renewals leaders. The team’s mission is to bring structure, rigor, and accountability to a Renewals function that is actively maturing: building the standardized forecasting cadence, governance, and operational infrastructure that Zoom’s scale now demands. By aligning data, tooling, and process across cross-functional partners, Retention Operations enables Renewals leadership to make faster, more confident decisions that protect and grow Zoom’s recurring revenue base.


Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end renewals and churn forecasting, including methodology refinement, model design, reporting, and operational cadence, serving as the primary point of contact for renewals forecasting in partnership with FP&A and Renewals leadership.
  • Establish quarterly and half-year churn and renewals forecasts by synthesizing predictive models, historical performance, business signals, and field inputs into a bottoms-up, account- and product-level outlook.
  • Drive measurable improvement in forecasting accuracy as the primary lagging metric, identifying and closing gaps between early-quarter assumptions and in-quarter actuals.
  • Continuously improve forecasting models in collaboration with Analytics and Data Science, incorporating leading indicators to increase accuracy, confidence, and visibility.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Renewals leadership, developing an independent, data-backed view of business performance and constructively challenging forecast assumptions when data indicates a different outcome.
  • Proactively identify and communicate material in-quarter changes based on shifts in model predictions, leading indicators, and business performance, independent of Renewal Manager (RM)-reported line of sight.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance on forecast assumptions, account ownership, renewal timing, risks, and execution.
  • Establish governance around renewal processes and programs, covering suspensions, account movement, deal hygiene, and end-to-end program performance tracking and optimization.
  • Build executive-ready reporting and insights that clearly articulate forecast movement, churn and contraction risk, key drivers, forecast gaps, and required actions.
  • Partner with Analytics and Data Science to evolve predictive capabilities, including churn-risk and renewal opportunity scoring, to improve prioritization and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Renewals leadership and Finance on long-range planning, capacity modeling, and target setting for the Renewals organization.
  • Identify and lead process, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce manual effort, improve RM productivity, and increase operational scalability.
  • Partner with Compensation and Finance on renewals compensation operations, including attainment calculations, quota setting, and payout validation.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in RevOps, SalesOps, RenewalOps, or RetentionOps with demonstrated ownership of forecasting and business performance in a recurring-revenue environment.
  • Proven ownership of renewals or retention forecasting methodology, with fluency in GRR, NRR, and churn metrics and experience translating those signals into bottoms-up forecasts and executive-ready insights.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to develop an independent, data-backed point of view, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence senior leaders across Renewals, Finance, and Customer Success.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building forecasts, dashboards, and executive reporting, translating complex data into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across cross-functional teams including Finance, Renewals, Customer Success, Analytics, and Data Science, including in environments with challenging stakeholder groups and limited prior operational support.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker; experience with Clari or equivalent revenue forecasting platforms strongly preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS or subscription-based tech with a track record of driving measurable improvements in forecasting accuracy, retention, or RM productivity, and the proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal process infrastructure.


Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$97,600.00 - $225,700.00

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

job.title: Audio AI Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As an Audio AI Engineer on Zoom's applied research team, you will advance the frontier of audio intelligence by developing and deploying machine-learning models that protect users from synthetic speech and audio deepfakes. Your work will have direct impact on platform trust and security, translating cutting-edge research into robust, production-ready systems. Each day brings a mix of independent experimentation, cross-functional collaboration with research, engineering, product, and security partners, and applied problem-solving at real-world scale. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our San Jose, California office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Zoom's AI Research and Engineering team operates at the intersection of innovation and product, building foundational capabilities that power Zoom Workplace experiences for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. The audio AI group is focused on speech intelligence, security, and trust, ensuring that voice and video communications remain authentic and protected as generative technologies evolve. Your contributions here influence the integrity of Zoom's platform and help shape the broader industry conversation around responsible AI.


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine-learning models for audio deepfake and synthetic speech detection.
  • Design training datasets, evaluation frameworks, and experimental pipelines for audio AI models.
  • Improve model accuracy and robustness across diverse speakers, languages, devices, codecs, and acoustic environments.
  • Analyze model failures and engineer solutions for reliable, real-world deployment.
  • Translate research prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with research, engineering, product, and security teams to align on priorities and ship impactful work.
  • Track and apply emerging developments in speech AI, generative audio, voice cloning, and deepfake detection.

What We're Looking For

  • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Speech/Audio Processing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Research or industry experience in audio deepfake detection, synthetic speech detection, anti-spoofing, or speaker recognition; experience with generative audio, voice cloning, or adversarial machine learning is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of speech and audio signal processing, with familiarity with large-scale or multilingual audio datasets a plus.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, model evaluation, and experimental design.
  • Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience deploying and optimizing ML models in production is a plus.
  • Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Publications in recognized speech, audio, AI, or machine learning venues are a plus; strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills required.

$137,700.00 - $275,400.00

job.title: Technical Consultant
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

In this role, you’ll focus on uncovering and addressing vulnerabilities across the Workvivo platform, including our Web App, Mobile App, Mobile and AWS Infrastructure.

You will be responsible for identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities within software applications through building security tools, code reviews, penetration testing, and security assessments.

We’re looking for people who will work closely with application engineering teams to ensure secure coding practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle, preventing security risks before they emerge. You will also provide security guidance to developers and other stakeholders, fostering a culture of security awareness within the organization
 

About the Team

Workvivo is an employee experience platform designed to amplify workplace culture and foster employee engagement, regardless of location. Committed to customer satisfaction, Workvivo focuses on enhancing employees' working lives across diverse industries globally. As part of Zoom, an intelligent collaboration platform, Workvivo aligns with Zoom's mission to prioritize people, enabling meaningful connections, modern collaboration, and driving innovation in businesses and individual interactions.

In this position, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the security of both Workvivo and Zoom. This includes contributing to our engineering security training program and collaborating cross-functionally within Zoom Security, including teams like Bug Bounty, Incident Response, SOC, Vulnerability Management, and Customer Security Assurance (CSA).
 

Responsibilities

  • Conducting regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software associated with the Workvivo Platform. Including, AWS Infrastructure and the Workvivo Application (Web App, Mobile App)
  • Discovering vulnerabilities associated with the Workvivo platform and associated infrastructure and work with Workvivo's/ZOOM's internal teams. Working daily with the Security, AWS Infrastructure & Application engineering teams and ensure Security, Scalability and Stability.
  • Prioritising the threat modeling of new security features before they are deployed. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Thus, working with Application engineering (and other teams) as early as possible in the design phase
  • Contributing to improving the SDLC such as advising on DAST, SAST, SCA, i.e., securing the Pipeline etc and introduce code automated security solutions.
  • Contributing to improving security across Workvivo & Zoom, including feeding into the Engineering Security training program.
  • Working cross functionally within Zoom Security, e.g. Bug Bounty, Incident Response, SOC, Vulnerability Management, Customer Security Assurance (CSA) etc.
  • Introducing and coding automated security solutions.


What we’re looking for

  • Have very good experience completing penetration test (focused on Web Applications, API and Mobile)
  • Able to critically analyse Vulnerability & Penetration test reports from external partners and customers
  • Can go beyond highlighting Security Headers and low hanging fruit as a vulnerability and critically challenge security vulnerabilities.
  • Have the ability to produce Architectural diagrams with a focus on the security control plane
  • Have experience in application security, software development, or related areas with a good understanding of secure coding practices and application security frameworks
  • Have good knowledge of AWS
  • Comfort with using Burpsuite / Invicti (Netsparker) and similar tooling
  • Have proficiency in a programming languages (such as PHP, Laravel, Go, Java, C++, etc.). Knowledge of security tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP), and familiarity with security protocols and encryption methods
  • Can go beyond highlighting Security Headers and low hanging fruit as a vulnerability. Are able to critically analyze Vulnerability & Penetration test reports from external partners and customers
  • Have excellent attention to detail, a sense of curiosity and ability to focus, and are comfortable discussing the latest security technology. Written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security issues to both technical and non-technical audiences

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What You Can Expect

As a Data Scientist on Zoom's Online business team, you'll apply machine learning and statistical modeling to understand user behavior, predict buying intent, and inform product decisions that affect how millions of people experience Zoom. Day to day, you'll build and validate predictive models, run experiments, and translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for cross-functional partners. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and marketers, you'll bring analytical rigor to some of the most consequential growth decisions in the company. This role is well suited to someone who moves comfortably between exploratory analysis and production-ready models, and who finds meaning in work that directly shapes user outcomes at scale.


About the Team

The Data Science team sits at the foundation of Zoom's growth strategy, powering decisions across product, marketing, and engineering with data-driven insights and machine learning capabilities. The team's work spans customer segmentation, churn modeling, personalization, and growth experimentation, all in service of improving user experience and business outcomes. You'll join a team that values intellectual rigor, cross-functional collaboration, and clear communication of complex ideas.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends and behavioral patterns related to buying journeys, customer intent, and user engagement across Zoom's self-serve products.
  • Build and validate predictive models and machine learning algorithms supporting personalization, churn prediction, customer segmentation, and recommendation systems.
  • Design and execute A/B tests, interpret results with statistical discipline, and translate findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across product, engineering, and marketing to understand business objectives and develop targeted analytical solutions.
  • Communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences through well-structured presentations and visualizations.
  • Partner with Data Engineers on pipeline development to ensure robust, scalable data infrastructure that supports model production.
  • Monitor model performance continuously and iterate on solutions to maintain accuracy and relevance as business conditions evolve.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in a data science or similar role, with a focus on building consumer-facing machine learning models.
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with A/B testing, customer segmentation, LTV prediction, or personalization models in a product or e-commerce context.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly).
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with comfort navigating ambiguity and translating analytical findings for diverse audiences.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or tools such as dbt, Databricks, Airflow, or MLflow is a plus.

job.title: Regional Event Marketing & Virtual Event Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As the Regional Event Marketing and Virtual Event Specialist, you will lead end-to-end execution of high-impact virtual and live events across the Americas, including virtual summits, tech talks, webinars, and exclusive customer hospitality activations. Working closely with Field Marketing, Sales, Channel, and Integrated Marketing teams, you will own the regional events calendar and serve as the central coordination hub for cross-functional campaign timing, deliverables, and operational rigor across all stakeholders. This role is built for an organized, detail-driven event professional who thrives on complexity, excels at keeping multiple programs on track simultaneously, and wants their work to directly shape how Zoom shows up for customers and prospects across the US, Canada, and Latin America. If you are eager to build modern experiential and virtual event capabilities that drive measurable pipeline growth, this role offers the scope, visibility, and cross-functional impact to do exactly that.


About the Team

The Events Marketing team sits within Americas Field Marketing and owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of Zoom's most impactful customer and prospect experiences. We partner closely with Sales, Channel, Integrated Marketing, and Industry teams to turn events into a strategic lever for pipeline and revenue growth across the US, Canada, and Latin America. As virtual and hybrid engagement continues to grow in importance, our team is committed to delivering seamless digital experiences that extend Zoom's brand reach well beyond the physical room.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end coordination for virtual programs including virtual customer experience events, digital engagement series, online customer community activations, and virtual executive briefings.
  • Own the coordination of event campaign creation, partner with field marketing managers on sales enablement, and collaborate with marketing operations to build event landing pages and schedule pre- and post-event email communications.
  • Serve as the central communications hub across the marketing team, coordinating timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional dependencies across Field Marketing, ABM, Channel, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing, and Industry teams.
  • Own the regional marketing calendar, ensuring alignment with the broader AMER marketing plan.
  • Track program performance across attendee engagement, NPS, pipeline influence, and brand sentiment.
  • Develop post-event insights and recommendations to continuously elevate the event portfolio.
