job.title: Senior Offensive AI Security Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role sits at the intersection of offensive security and applied AI, focused on surfacing critical risks across Zoom's products, applications, services, and infrastructure before they become incidents. Day to day, you will combine deep target knowledge, threat analysis, and cutting edge models to form hypotheses about where complex systems are likely to fail, validate exploitability, and trace attack paths that standard testing would miss. This is not a vulnerability-scanning or prompt-engineering role: a strong hands-on research craft is the foundation, and success is measured by whether your findings change how Zoom understands its risk, not by finding volume. Research directions are chosen in collaboration with the Security Assurance teams (Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Bug Bounty, PSIRT), but most work is self-directed, with high autonomy and no predetermined outcome.


About the Team

Zoom's Offensive Security team conducts vulnerability research across products, applications, and infrastructure, concentrating on high-impact issues that escape standard secure development processes or wouldn't surface through routine testing. The team is actively evolving towards AI-native research, where models extend how much ground experienced security engineers can cover and how quickly, paired with real target knowledge, a sound research strategy, and rigorous verification.


Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI to conduct vulnerability research across Zoom's products, applications, services, and infrastructure, with a focus on high-impact issues, subtle vulnerabilities, confirmed exploitability, and attack paths that cross component and trust boundaries.
  • Use experience, threat analysis, architecture knowledge, source code, and observed system behavior to choose targets and guide investigations.
  • Apply frontier and open-weight models, agents, and other AI capabilities across the research lifecycle: reconnaissance, code analysis, hypothesis generation, exploit development, and verification.
  • Design and tune research harnesses that give models the right context, tools, execution environments, and feedback to investigate real targets.
  • Develop custom tooling, including analysis utilities, fuzzers, agents, test harnesses, proofs of concept, and full exploits, when it helps answer the research question.
  • Convert promising model output into defensible security evidence: reproduce findings, rule out false claims, establish preconditions, and distinguish a possible weakness from a demonstrated vulnerability with real impact.
  • Improve the reliability and reach of AI-driven research by tackling false positives, false negatives, context limits, nondeterminism, and reproducibility.
  • Work directly with Engineering and Product Security to communicate findings, support remediation, surface related risks, and verify fixes.
  • Share tools, techniques, and lessons learned so Security Assurance and the broader Security org can enhance their processes through the use of AI.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on vulnerability research, offensive security, application security, or penetration testing, with a demonstrated track record of choosing targets, forming and revising hypotheses, and establishing exploitability and impact in complex software or production systems.
  • Hands-on experience running offensive workflows with frontier and open-weight models, including model selection where refusal behavior would otherwise block legitimate exploit development.
  • Experience assessing the quality of AI-driven research processes, including identifying false positives, missed vulnerabilities, unstable results, and reproducibility gaps, as well as sound judgment on agent architecture trade-offs: when constrained, orchestrated pipelines deliver reproducible results and when open-ended tool-using agents are worth the nondeterminism.
  • Deep technical expertise in at least one security domain: web applications and APIs, Java applications, cloud or service infrastructure, client software, operating systems, or reverse engineering.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills: ability to read unfamiliar code, build research tooling, write proofs of concept, and trace behavior across system boundaries.
  • Strong intuition for attack surfaces, trust boundaries, exploitability, and security impact, combined with the persistence to work independently on open-ended research with no guaranteed path or outcome.
  • Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences, covering what the evidence shows, what remains uncertain, and why it matters.


Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$124,000.00 - $271,200.00


In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

job.title: Senior General Ledger Accountant
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Accountant on Zoom’s General Ledger team, you will take ownership of the full accounting lifecycle for capitalized software, including Internal Use Software and Cloud Computing Arrangements, while contributing broadly to close processes, financial reporting, and balance sheet integrity. You will work at the intersection of technical accounting and innovation, partnering with Engineering, FP&A, IT, and Finance to ensure transactions are accurately recorded and reported. This is a visible, high-impact role where your expertise shapes not only the numbers but also how AI-assisted automation transforms the controllership function. You will have the opportunity to influence the future of finance operations in a dynamic, remote-first environment.


About the Team

Zoom’s General Ledger team sits within the Finance and Accounting organization, playing a foundational role in maintaining the accuracy and integrity of Zoom’s financial statements. The team operates in a fast-paced, public company environment where precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement are core expectations. We work closely with cross-functional partners across Engineering, FP&A, IT, and Finance to deliver reliable financial reporting and support Zoom’s strategic priorities.



Responsibilities

  • Support the accounting lifecycle for Internal Use Software (IUS) and Cloud Computing Arrangements (CCA), including capitalization tracking, project cost coordination, roll forward reconciliation, policy documentation, and journal entries in compliance with ASC 350-40.
  • Prepare and post journal entries including accruals, expense allocations, and other adjusting entries with appropriate supporting documentation, leveraging and improving automated processes where possible.
  • Maintain and reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts in compliance with US GAAP, investigating and resolving reconciling items in a timely manner.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly variance analyses comparing actuals to prior periods, and partner with FP&A to clearly explain significant P&L and balance sheet fluctuations.
  • Support the financial reporting cycle by preparing and assembling reporting packages, including management-level P&L summaries, variance analyses, and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, SOX controls, and company accounting policies through periodic control testing activities that validate the design and operating effectiveness of key controls.
  • Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes and serve as a key contributor to external and internal audit activities, including preparing PBC schedules and coordinating evidence gathering.
  • Collaborate with Finance and IT to evaluate and implement AI-driven tools, automation solutions, and ERP improvements, providing functional accounting expertise and participating in testing and validation activities.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve data quality, and increase automation across general ledger activities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience, with 5 or more years of progressive accounting experience including at least 2 years in a public company environment.
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP with hands-on experience in accrual accounting, cost allocations, and the full month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycle.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar enterprise platforms, combined with advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large data sets and complex reconciliations.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and automation to accelerate day-to-day accounting tasks, with an interest in shaping how technology transforms accounting workflows.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently, meet firm deadlines in a high-volume close environment, and communicate accounting concepts clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • CPA license or active CPA candidacy, with experience at a public accounting firm supporting public companies (preferred).
  • Working knowledge of SOX 404 compliance and ASC 350-40 (Internal Use Software and CCA accounting), ideally with experience supporting engineering or technical teams in a SaaS or technology environment (preferred).

job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo enhances organizational connections, engagement, and communication through its AI-powered employee experience platform. Acquired by Zoom in 2023, it blends SaaS agility with global technology innovation.

The Field Marketing Manager EMEA oversees regional marketing efforts. Responsibilities include executing a tiered ABM strategy for key accounts, creating regional field calendars, and collaborating closely with Sales teams to drive pipeline growth.

This impactful role requires managing regional initiatives, fostering partnerships, and delivering measurable results. It offers an opportunity to lead efforts and build meaningful collaborations.

The position operates in a hybrid capacity from Ireland or the Netherlands.

About the Team

You'll join the Global Field & Strategic Events team, sitting within the broader Growth & Demand Generation function. Our buyers are enterprise leaders including CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications leaders, so this role is built around account based marketing as its operating model.

Responsibilities

  • Executing the EMEA field marketing strategy as a tiered ABM approach: 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account groups, and 1:many for broader segments.

  • Building and managing the regional field calendar in collaboration with Sales and SDR leadership, customized to account tier, concentration, and deal stage.

  • Owning a pipeline target for the EMEA region, generating and accelerating pipeline across all account levels, and maintaining consistent standards with other demand channels.

  • Supporting the strategy and execution of global flagship events, such as Workvivo Engage, as part of the broader ABX initiative in EMEA.

  • Managing the regional field and events budget while ensuring accountability for pipeline efficiency rather than focusing solely on event volume or attendance.

  • Building and maintaining the transition process with Sales Development and Sales ensures every account receives timely, coordinated follow-up aligned with the origin's engagement level. Partnering with Revenue Operations to manage attribution and route leads effectively across all three tiers within the United States.

  • Executing the playbooks and processes outlined by the Global Lead of Field and Strategic Events while contributing to their continuous improvement.

  • Representing EMEA field and events performance in regional and global reporting, with pipeline contribution as the primary focus.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in field marketing, ABM, or integrated marketing, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment.

  • Demonstrate experience executing a tiered ABM motion: 1:1 for top accounts, 1:few for clusters, and 1:many/ABX for scale - not just familiarity with the concept.

  • Demonstrate expertise in optimizing pipeline efficiency beyond event volume, focusing on cost-effectiveness and measurable outcomes rather than attendance or brand metrics.

  • Manage a regional field budget and report pipeline contributions to senior leadership effectively and accurately.

  • Collaborate effectively across functions while working closely with Sales, Sales Development, and Demand Generation teams to achieve shared objectives.

  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology. Demonstrate knowledge in HR technology, employee experience, or a related field.

  • Present performance data and strategy effectively to senior leadership.

  • Reside in the EMEA region and travel regionally when necessary.

job.title: Chat Product Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


As the Product Manager for Zoom Chat’s enterprise layer, you will own the admin controls, compliance frameworks, and cross-organization capabilities that large and regulated customers depend on. Your primary partners are the IT, security, and compliance teams who govern messaging across their organizations, and you will set product direction for their needs. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Security, and Legal to deliver experiences that are technically rigorous and operationally meaningful. This role is well suited for a technical product manager who is energized by the systems and infrastructure behind enterprise adoption at scale. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence two (2) days per week at our Seattle, WA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team


The Zoom Chat Product Team builds the messaging experiences millions of people rely on to get work done, along with the enterprise capabilities that allow organizations of any size to deploy Chat securely and at scale. We ship fast and adapt just as quickly, without compromising the trust our customers place in us.


Responsibilities


  • Own the admin, compliance, and external collaboration roadmap end to end, from strategy and requirements through delivery and post-launch iteration.
  • Define admin settings and policy controls that scale from small businesses to large, regulated enterprises.
  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into product requirements in partnership with Security and Legal.
  • Build admin analytics and dashboards that give IT and compliance teams visibility into usage, adoption, and policy.
  • Shape the permissions and trust model for external users and shared channels across organizations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders to scope, sequence, and deliver features against committed timelines.
  • Communicate roadmap, tradeoffs, and progress to stakeholders across product, engineering, and go-to-market.
  • Drive a consistent, unified experience across desktop, mobile, and web clients.

What We’re Looking For


  • 5 to 8 years of product management experience with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a product or major product surface.
  • Experience with messaging, collaboration, or communication products.
  • Experience with enterprise admin, security, and compliance.
  • Direct experience shipping AI-powered product features, with the ability to articulate the product decisions behind them.
  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture, APIs, permissions, and data models alongside engineering teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to frame tradeoffs for both engineering and executive audiences.
  • Comfortable with a flexible schedule to support real-time collaboration with globally distributed teams, including regular early morning or evening meetings.

job.title: General Manager, Zoom Workplace
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As the General Manager of Zoom Workplace, you own the full strategic and revenue trajectory of one of the most widely used collaboration platforms in the world, directly shaping how hundreds of millions of people work every day. You define and execute the multi-year growth strategy across the entire Zoom Workplace portfolio, from competitive positioning and product-market fit to market expansion and AI-powered differentiation. Day-to-day, you work across geo sales, global customer success, product, engineering, and marketing to align strategy with execution at the highest level. Reporting directly to the Chief Sales Officer, you will present regularly to the CEO and Board of Directors and serve as the definitive voice of the Workplace business across the organization.


About the Team

The Zoom Workplace team owns the core collaboration suite that anchors Zoom’s platform, spanning Meetings, Team Chat, Rooms, Clips, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and the full suite of productivity and space management products. This team operates at the intersection of product strategy, field execution, and customer impact, partnering across every major function at Zoom to define what modern work looks like at scale. As Zoom accelerates its AI-first platform vision, the Workplace business is at the center of that transformation.


Responsibilities

  • Define the multi-year strategic roadmap for Zoom Workplace, translating Zoom’s AI-first platform vision into an executable growth plan that captures market share, expands total addressable market, and drives net new ARR.
  • Own the competitive strategy, pricing, and go-to-market motion for the Workplace portfolio, partnering with Pricing, Channel, and Marketing to maximize competitive wins and defend the installed base.
  • Drive new business acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, and expansion motions across Zoom’s global customer base, with a relentless focus on ARR growth and net retention.
  • Partner with Geo Sales Leadership across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and Japan to localize Workplace strategies, deploy specialist resources, and build the enablement infrastructure for disciplined field execution.
  • Collaborate with Global Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to influence the product roadmap, accelerate customer adoption, and connect product usage directly to retention and expansion outcomes.
  • Champion the integration of AI across every Workplace product, positioning Zoommate, AI Slides, AI Docs, AI Sheets, and next-generation AI capabilities as transformational differentiators in the market.
  • Establish and track KPIs across the Workplace business, including revenue growth, ARR expansion, pipeline velocity, win rates, competitive displacement, product adoption, and market share, building a disciplined operating cadence across the organization.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing cross-functional team of specialist sellers, solution engineers, and business development professionals, leading through influence in a matrixed organization.
  • Represent the Workplace business to the CEO, executive staff, and Board of Directors with crisp, data-driven narratives on performance, risk, opportunity, and strategic direction.


What We’re Looking For

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership in SaaS, enterprise software, or collaboration technology, with at least 7 years in senior GTM or general management roles overseeing a $100M+ ARR business with direct P&L or revenue ownership.
  • Demonstrated success driving market share growth, competitive displacement, and customer expansion in the UCaaS, collaboration, or productivity platform space, with deep knowledge of competitive dynamics against Microsoft, Google, Cisco, and comparable players.
  • Proven experience operating at the executive level with direct exposure to CEO, C-suite, and Board-level reporting and decision-making.
  • Deep understanding of the modern workplace technology landscape, including meetings, messaging, voice, video, rooms/spaces, and AI-powered productivity tools, with strong grasp of hybrid work trends and enterprise buying behaviors.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale cross-functional GTM teams, leading through influence in matrixed organizations and developing talent at senior levels.
  • Strong command of direct and indirect go-to-market models, including channel/partner ecosystems, PLG motions, and SMB through enterprise segments.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to engage with product and engineering leadership on roadmap prioritization and AI-driven differentiation, with working knowledge of Salesforce and analytics platforms.

job.title: WebRTC Video Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a WebRTC Video Engineer on Zoom's real-time web media team, you will directly shape the video quality that millions of users depend on for clear, reliable communication. Working across the full media pipeline, from device capture and encoding through network transmission, decoding, and rendering, you will develop code to deliver the best video quality to the customers, diagnose and resolve complex quality issues across browsers, operating systems, and hardware environments. You will collaborate closely with global engineering teams to drive product development and release cycles. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Audio Video team is Zoom's technical foundation for real-time communication, owning the full media pipeline from device capture through processing, encoding, transmission, decoding, and rendering. The team delivers the audio and video experience across Zoom Workplace's native client, web-based client, and Video SDK, enabling developers and enterprise customers to build reliable, high-quality communication tools. By continuously advancing media quality and reliability, the team plays a central role in supporting Zoom's mission to keep people connected and productive.


Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain robust WebRTC media flows across web browsers, native clients, and media servers, including interoperability across these environments.
  • Develop and improve core modules for SDP negotiation, peer connection management, ICE/STUN/TURN, simulcast, packet switch architecture, and adaptive bitrate and congestion control.
  • Investigate and resolve audio/video quality issues, including codec compatibility for H.264, VP8/VP9, and AV1, hardware decoder edge cases, and browser-specific regressions.
  • Optimize end-to-end audio/video workflows across capture, encoding, transport, decoding, and rendering for conferencing use cases.
  • Monitor QoS performance, implement failover metrics, and analyze quality regressions using data-driven methods.
  • Ensure production stability through hotfix deployment, memory leak resolution, and proactive issue identification across production clusters.
  • Deliver US-facing technical support for enterprise SDK customers, covering requirements discussions, ticket investigation, troubleshooting, and integration guidance.
  • Build and maintain team knowledge bases, internal documentation, and best practices for WebRTC systems, and contribute to open-source communities such as Chromium and WebRTC upstream where applicable.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent experience, with 5 or more years of hands-on software engineering experience in real-time media or web communication systems.
  • Solid, production-proven WebRTC development experience, including real-world debugging, protocol-level issue resolution, and cross-browser compatibility work.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript for front-end media development, with strong debugging skills including packet-level analysis and use of media and protocol tooling.
  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols, including ICE, STUN/TURN, DTLS/SRTP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP, with practical experience in SDP parsing, negotiation, and RFC compliance across browser environments.
  • Familiarity with video codec internals, particularly H.264 (including SPS/PPS, key frames, and hardware decoder compatibility), and awareness of VP8/VP9 and AV1.
  • Experience with simulcast, packet switch flows, or adaptive bitrate mechanisms in a media SDK or media server context.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve production issues, including hotfixes, memory leaks, and browser-specific regressions, with experience supporting enterprise SDK customers technically as a plus.

$127,700.00 - $255,400.00

As Sales Development Representative Manager for Workvivo's AMER and LATAM region, you will own the full performance and development of a regional SDR team operating across both outbound and inbound motions. This is a hands-on leadership role at a meaningful moment for Workvivo: with the recent launches of Seer and Workvivo HQ, the team has a compelling, expanded story to bring to enterprise CHROs, CTOs, and Internal Comms leaders across two high-growth markets. Day to day, you will build coaching culture, translate global strategy into regional execution, and partner closely with Sales and Marketing to ensure the team delivers consistent, high-quality pipeline. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our Boston, MA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Workvivo, now part of Zoom, is an employee communications and insights platform serving mid-market and enterprise companies globally, with buyers that include CHROs, CTOs, CIOs, and Internal Comms Directors. Our AMER and LATAM SDR team operates a balanced motion: structured outbound sequencing into target accounts alongside managed inbound response, with a clear focus on pipeline quality over volume. The team runs within Zoom's worldwide network, giving you the backing and resources to build at scale while maintaining the pace and ambition of a high-growth product.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver against regional meeting, SQO, and pipeline targets by owning AMER and LATAM SDR performance, with clear focus on the inputs and behaviors that drive results

  • 2+ years of experience managing SDR or BDR teams in a B2B SaaS environment, with a proven track record of delivering against pipeline, meeting, and revenue targets
  • Experience leading both outbound and inbound SDR motions, with a strong understanding of what drives conversion across each
  • Coaching-first leadership approach, with demonstrated experience listening to calls, running role-plays, and actively developing rep capability

This role blends deep product ownership with a strong commercial mindset, giving you the opportunity to shape a competitive, differentiated platform that helps revenue teams identify the right prospects, personalize outreach, automate execution, and generate more qualified pipeline. You’ll work alongside a fast-moving, collaborative team at the intersection of AI innovation and real-world customer impact. job.title: Principal, Global PX Operations Lead
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Global People Experience Operations Lead, you serve as the operational engine behind Zoom’s People function and the right hand to the Global Head of PX Operations. You will turn strategy into shipped process, working systems, and metrics that hold up in front of executives, with genuine ownership over platform design, service architecture, and automation delivery. Your work centers on rebuilding Zoom’s ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform, architecting a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, and embedding AI and automation into people processes that reach every Zoomie worldwide. Impact here is measured in concrete outputs: SLA compression, deflection rate, first-contact resolution, hours returned to the business, and ROI on every solution you ship.


About the Team

PX Operations is the shared services and operational backbone of Zoom’s People function, delivering across a matrixed, multi-region model spanning India, the Philippines, Mexico, and other global markets. The team supports Zoom’s overall business strategy by helping identify, hire, onboard, develop, and reward Zoomies while continuously improving the employee experience. Working here means partnering across a global community of coordinators, specialists, and CoE stakeholders to build a People function that scales with the business.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform rebuild, covering catalog architecture, case taxonomy, routing logic, knowledge management, approval workflows, and integrations with Workday and adjacent systems.
  • Architect and operationalize a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, building self-service capabilities, operating standards, escalation protocols, and governance frameworks across the global PX Ops community.
  • Design, deploy, and measure AI-powered and automated workflows across employee support, onboarding, offboarding, and talent acquisition operations, applying systems thinking to eliminate waste and compress cycle times.
  • Define and own the PX Operations reporting layer, including metrics frameworks, executive dashboards, and cadenced reporting on SLA compliance, deflection rates, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and ROI.
  • Drive global process harmonization across regional teams, establishing governance for AI and automation deployment that includes model validation, bias safeguards, audit trails, and compliance documentation.
  • Partner with CoEs, Payroll, Legal, IT, and Engineering on cross-functional escalations and platform integrations, representing PX Operations at senior stakeholder forums and serving as deputy to the Global Head of PX Operations.
  • Coach and enable the global PX Ops coordinator community on process discipline, tooling, and data literacy, raising capability across the offshore and onshore delivery model.


What We’re Looking For

  • 8 to 10 or more years of experience in HR/People Operations, shared services, HR technology, or transformation, with demonstrable ownership of operational delivery at enterprise scale within a multi-tier, multi-region organization.
  • Deep, hands-on ServiceNow expertise (HRSD strongly preferred), including at least one end-to-end platform rebuild or major redesign you led or co-led, plus strong Workday proficiency and experience with HRIS-to-case-management integration.
  • Proven track record designing and operating Tier 0 through Tier 3 service models, with documented results across SLA attainment, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, and CSAT.
  • Demonstrated AI and automation delivery experience with quantified outcomes, such as hours saved, volume deflected, cycle time reduced, or cost avoided.
  • Advanced data analysis skills and the ability to build and present executive-ready dashboards and stakeholder reporting, with fluency in translating analysis into clear recommendations.
  • Process improvement expertise through systems thinking methodologies such as Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis, and Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or above preferred), combined with experience driving global process harmonization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent business experience, and the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion across multiple regulatory environments.

job.title: Staff AI Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You'll design, implement, and own the inference systems that serve Zoom's AI models at production scale -- across real-time communication, vision, and language workloads. You'll be hands-on with kernel-level optimisation, inference framework internals, and production serving infrastructure, working closely with research and platform teams to push the boundary on latency, throughput, and cost.


About the Team

You will join a dynamic AI Infrastructure team focused on enabling high-performance AI across Zoom's products and services. The team builds the core systems that support model training, deployment, and inference at scale, driving innovation in areas such as real-time communication, computer vision, and natural language understanding.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-performance inference serving systems for large-scale transformer and multimodal models (including 100B+ and MoE architectures)
  • Implement and tune inference optimisations: speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache management, prefill/decode disaggregation, and quantisation (INT4/INT8/FP8)
  • Contribute to and customise inference frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or equivalent) for Zoom's production requirements
  • Write and profile CUDA kernels and custom ops where framework-level optimisation is insufficient
  • Own end-to-end deployment: from model packaging and serving API design to latency SLO monitoring and incident response
  • Partner with research to translate model architecture changes into inference-efficient implementations
  • Drive technical design and set the bar for inference engineering practices across the team

What We're Looking For

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent on inference systems or ML infrastructure at production depth
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major inference framework: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or ONNX Runtime (serving, not just export)
  • GPU programming experience: CUDA kernel development, memory optimisation, and profiling with Nsight or equivalent tools
  • Production experience serving LLMs or large vision models -- you've owned latency SLOs, debugged throughput regressions, and shipped optimisations that moved the needle
  • Depth in at least two of: speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache design, quantisation pipelines, prefill/decode disaggregation
  • Strong systems instincts in Python and C++; ability to read and modify framework internals

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical field
  • Experience with MoE models or 100B+ parameter deployments
  • Familiarity with disaggregated serving architectures or multi-node inference
  • Background in compiler-level optimisation (XLA, Triton, or similar)

job.title: Senior Data Engineering Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


This role sits at the center of how Zoom’s Online business uses data to make critical decisions. You’ll lead a globally distributed team of data engineers, ML engineers, and data visualization engineers, driving high-impact outcomes across billing, checkout, growth, and revenue analytics. As a technical leader, you’ll set architectural direction and partner with Data Science, Finance, and Product to shape the infrastructure that powers business insights at scale. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our Seattle, WA or San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Online Data team owns the data pipelines, ML models, and reporting that underpin Zoom’s Online business, covering billing, checkout, funnel analytics, and revenue reporting. Globally distributed and deeply cross-functional, the team partners closely with Data Science, Fraud, Online Business, Finance, Marketing, and IT services to deliver reliable, data-driven outcomes at scale.


Responsibilities


  • Lead and grow a cross-functional team of data engineers, ML engineers, and data visualization engineers.
  • Own the roadmap and delivery of scalable data pipelines, data models, and infrastructure supporting Online business analytics, including funnel, billing, checkout, and revenue.
  • Partner with Data Science, Finance, and Product stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable, well-governed data assets.
  • Drive data quality, classification and access control compliance, and platform reliability across Snowflake, Databricks, and Zoom’s big-data platform ecosystem.
  • Define technical direction on data architecture, pipeline design, and tooling selection, including evaluation and adoption of new BI and analytics platforms.
  • Manage team performance, hiring, mentorship, and career development to build and retain high-performing engineering talent.
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership on headcount planning, prioritization, and capacity allocation.

What We’re Looking For


  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, including 3+ years leading and managing engineering teams.
  • Proven track record building and scaling production data pipelines and data platforms, with hands-on experience across Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, and dbt.
  • Strong foundation in data modeling, ETL/ELT architecture, and data governance and access control practices.
  • Experience collaborating with Finance, Business, and Data Science stakeholders on revenue, billing, or growth analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing engineering talent, with excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences.

job.title: Manager of Platform DevOps
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will be the leader of our Platforms DevOps team.  This team is responsible for Zoom’s Kubernetes clusters in both datacenters and clouds, as well as for our cloudops infrastructure.  The scope and mandate of the team are broad, and you will have significant opportunities to partner with teams across Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and Security. You'll drive projects that enable new features, improve infrastructure reliability and security, and reduce costs. Within the team, you'll manage technical ICs and continuously improve processes with automation, policy, and AI.

Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE/DevOps leader with expertise running k8s, and knowledge of best practices for IaC, automation, monitoring, and security.  You also have experience communicating nuanced concepts to diverse audiences (e.g. both engineers and senior management). job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Staff Software Development Engineer on the Onyx team, you'll work at the intersection of enterprise search and generative AI, contributing to a platform that processes millions of queries weekly for organizations like NASA and Hudson River Trading. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role on a small, founder-led team: you'll drive problems from initial discovery through production, with direct visibility into customer outcomes and the open-source community. Working closely with Zoom's AI research and product teams, you'll shape both the technical direction of a growing product and the engineering practices that support it. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our San Francisco, CA office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Onyx joined Zoom through acquisition and is building enterprise search and an AI platform for security-conscious organizations. In under three years, the platform grew to hundreds of thousands of users, over one million queries per week, and 30,000 GitHub stars, serving customers including NASA, Hudson River Trading, and Nebius. Our team of roughly a dozen engineers operates across the full product line, from infrastructure and engineering to customer relationships, and works in close collaboration with Zoom's AI research teams on LLMs, classifiers, and embedding models.


Responsibilities

  • Build capabilities across the Onyx platform that translate advances in NLP and generative AI into reliable, high-value customer experiences.
  • Solve deep technical challenges in search quality, scalability, and performance at the scale of terabytes of enterprise data.
  • Own problems from discovery through design, implementation, and production operation, with full accountability for customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Zoom's AI and product teams to develop integrations that amplify value across both product lines and deepen Onyx's competitive position.

  • Shape technical direction and engineering practices as the team and product scale.
  • Contribute across the full scope of a growing product line, including engineering, infrastructure, rollouts, and exposure to go-to-market initiatives.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous problems to reliable solutions with high ownership and substantial, measurable results.
  • Proficiency with the latest AI development tools, paired with clear opinions on maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability as engineering practices evolve.
  • Strong backend engineering experience in complex, data-intensive systems; frontend skills are a plus.

job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Platforms
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Lead Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be one of the technical leads for our DevOps Platforms organization. This group is responsible for DevOps Platforms including cloud infrastructure, physical data center orchestration, critical security services, and our Zoom for Government (ZfG) environment. You will be an uber tech lead working across a broad area, defining projects and guiding work across various teams. Your scope of work is wide and you will have the opportunity to improve our datacenter kubernetes infrastructure, our cloud infrastructure, our security posture, and our operation of ZfG environments. Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE and you will guide all of our teams toward SRE best practices (automation, monitoring, infrastructure as code, etc).

About the Team

The DevOps Platforms organization owns the full infrastructure stack: cloud infrastructure on AWS and OCI, physical data center orchestration, critical security services (identity, authentication, authorization), and Zoom's FedRAMP-rated federal environment, Zoom for Government (ZfG).

The team is currently working on one of the most technically interesting work in the org, hardening our security posture, and building the automation and reliability systems that underpin Zoom's global services. If you want broad visibility, real cross-team influence, and the chance to define how infrastructure gets built, this is the seat.

Responsibilities

  • Design and scale DevOps platform services including Kubernetes infrastructure, cloud systems, and compliance-ready environments
  • Define technical roadmaps and architectural direction for infrastructure automation and security
  • Partner with service teams to understand platform needs and deliver solutions that improve reliability and efficiency
  • Establish and advocate for SRE best practices including infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident management
  • Mentor team members through design, implementation, and production deployment of complex systems

What We're Looking For

  • Bring 8+ years of SRE or DevOps experience building and operating production infrastructure at scale

  • Operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, OCI, or similar platforms using Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Implement observability solutions with logging and monitoring tools such as ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences including security teams, senior leadership, and external auditors

  • Hold a degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

job.description:
What You Can Expect


As a Software Engineer on our platform team, you will own and deliver full features independently, building reliable APIs and data infrastructure that directly shape the customer experience. Your technical instincts for scalability, observability, and performance will help keep our systems ahead of product demand, giving the broader engineering organization a strong foundation to build on. You will collaborate with experienced application and front-end engineers, using customer problems as your primary input for designing clean, maintainable solutions. Candidates who do not have meaningful backend engineering experience or are uncomfortable working at the intersection of systems design and product development are unlikely to be a strong fit for this role.


About the Team


Our engineering team builds the data infrastructure and intelligence systems that power Zoom’s go-to-market platform, bringing together signals, data orchestration, and execution workflows in one unified environment. We operate at the intersection of scale and complexity, supporting organizations that depend on reliable, real-time data to move faster and smarter. Our work directly influences how Zoom’s GTM teams and customers drive outcomes, making our systems among the most strategically important in the company.


Responsibilities


  • Design and build infrastructure, data models, and APIs that power core platform features and resolve real customer problems at scale.
  • Ship well-designed, testable code with a consistent focus on performance, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Own core internal infrastructure and ML systems, ensuring they reliably serve the evolving needs of customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Analyze complex system challenges and deliver simple, elegant solutions that account for observability, SLA commitments, and long-term scalability.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems and API development.

job.title: Scale Campaigns & ABM Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams.

It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts.

About the Team

This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts.

The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale.

  • Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions.

  • Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions.

  • Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies.

  • Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts.

  • Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships.

  • Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume.

  • Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace.

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment.

  • Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms.

  • Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively.

  • Direct experience as an SDR or working alongside SDR and AE teams on the same accounts, with shared ownership of outcomes.

  • Comfort presenting account level and pipeline metrics to stakeholders in clear, accessible language.

  • Operate effectively across various regions or markets.

  • Develop an ABM function from an initial or unstructured phase into a well-organized, tiered approach.

  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology within an organization utilizing a distributed or hybrid sales structure.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect


As a Technical Support Engineer on Zoom’s Escalation Engineering team, you’ll function as the highest level of technical escalation within Zoom Support, owning complex, sensitive, and high-priority customer cases from initial report through full resolution. Working at the intersection of customer advocacy and engineering collaboration, you’ll use advanced diagnostic tools including log analysis, packet captures, and SIP traces to solve issues that few others can. This is a role for someone who thrives on hard technical problems, communicates with equal clarity across engineering and executive audiences, and takes genuine pride in the quality of every customer interaction. Beyond resolving cases, you’ll mentor Tier 2 support teams and contribute customer insights that directly shape Zoom’s product roadmap.


About the Team


The Escalation Engineering team is Zoom’s premier technical support function, responsible for resolving the most technically complex and sensitive support situations across all of Zoom’s products. Reporting to a Technical Support Manager, you’ll collaborate with engineering, product, and global support teams to maintain a consistent, high-quality customer experience. The team covers the full spectrum of challenges, from single-user connectivity issues to Zoom’s most critical, large-scale support events.


Responsibilities


  • Own all escalated support cases as the single technical point of contact, driving each from initial intake through full resolution and closure.
  • Deliver deep technical troubleshooting using logs, diagnostic tools, industry best practices, and proprietary systems to resolve complex customer issues.
  • Partner with engineering teams to reproduce, test, and deploy fixes and workarounds, including hotfixes, debug builds, server updates, and client releases.
  • Confirm solution effectiveness with customers prior to case closure, ensuring complete resolution and customer satisfaction.
  • Document case progress with clear, comprehensive updates that serve customer visibility, stakeholder insight, and internal collaboration.
  • Lead critical escalation meetings, including P0/P1 reviews, and sensitive conversations with technical and executive stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
  • Engage in engineering war rooms immediately upon major incident declarations and communicate status updates across the support organization.

What You Can Expect


We are building pipeline at scale in a market that's rapidly maturing. As a Commercial BDR, you will identify buyers, test strategies, and drive revenue growth.

Common Room is an AI platform that consolidates buyer signals into one view, enabling teams to identify targets, craft messages, and determine timing effectively.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for an innovative and skilled Staff Software Engineer to join our Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) team. The focus will be on improving the quality, reliability, and performance of Zoom's AI-powered virtual agent - an intelligent system that autonomously resolves customer inquiries before escalating to a human agent.


About the Team

The Zoom Virtual Agent team is committed to transforming customer experience through AI-driven automation. We are passionate about building intelligent, production-grade systems that handle real customer interactions at scale - reducing the need for human escalation and delivering faster, more accurate resolutions. We operate with a startup mentality: fast-moving, high-ownership, and focused on building foundational technology that will define the future of AI-powered customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnosing and resolving AI agent quality issues — identifying whether failures stem from model behavior, prompt design, or system architecture, and driving the fix end-to-end.
  • Designing and optimizing system prompt architectures, few-shot examples, and prompt chains to improve agent reliability, accuracy, and resolution rates.
  • Building and maintaining evaluation pipelines to continuously measure agent quality, detect regressions, and validate improvements before production deployment.
  • Architecting scalable, maintainable systems that support high-performance AI agent operation at scale.
  • Collaborating with product managers, model teams, and engineering leadership across US and China time zones to align on quality goals and delivery timelines.
  • Setting the technical direction for agent quality on the team — mentor engineers, influence the roadmap, and drive measurable improvements in customer-facing outcomes.

What we’re looking for

  • Have an advance degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with rich system architecture knowledge & skills. With at least 3–5 years working directly on AI-powered products, LLM-based systems, or conversational AI agents in production.
  • Have track record of diagnosing and improving AI agent quality — with specific examples of identifying failure modes and driving measurable improvements.
  • Have prompt engineering skills, including system prompt design, context management, and prompt chain optimization. Having DSPy/APO/GEPA experience is a plus.
  • Have engineering scope — experience leading technical direction for a product area or team, with the ability to both design systems and execute on them.
  • Have experience deploying and operating LLM-based systems in production at scale — not just research or prototyping.
  • Have experience with ML or model training is a plus — candidates who have transitioned from MLE into SWE roles are strongly welcomed.

job.title: Customer Advocacy Program Manager, Zoom Contact Center
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As the dedicated Customer Advocacy Program Manager for Zoom Contact Center, you will own the end-to-end customer advocacy lifecycle for Zoom's CX product line, turning customer voices into a strategic engine that drives market proof, AI visibility, and competitive differentiation. Working closely with Product Marketing, GTM, and Customer Success teams, you will build and manage a pipeline of customer stories, secure references for analyst evaluations, lead the always-on reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, and steward the CX Council as a vehicle for deepening long-term advocate relationships. This role sits at a meaningful intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone equally comfortable shaping the advocacy roadmap for a high-growth product line and rolling up their sleeves to source the next customer reference. If you are energized by the full advocacy lifecycle and want to make the customer voice a core pillar of how Zoom Contact Center goes to market, this is the role for you.


About the Team

The Customer Advocacy team is part of Zoom's broader Content and Marketing organization, responsible for building the customer evidence that drives awareness, consideration, and pipeline across Zoom's product portfolio. We work at the intersection of customer relationships, product marketing, and go-to-market strategy, turning real customer experiences into stories, references, reviews, and council engagements that build trust in the market. Our work directly supports analyst evaluations, demand generation, and Zoom's AI visibility across the modern buyer journey.


Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a pipeline of Zoom Contact Center customer stories in video and written formats for Zoom.com, media, and press opportunities, managing the full lifecycle from customer identification through final publication.
  • Identify and place customer speakers for CX-related owned and third-party events and webinars, matching the right advocates to the right moments across the marketing calendar.
  • Partner with Analyst Relations, Product Marketing, and GTM to identify and secure strong customer references for key analyst evaluations including Gartner, IDC, and Forrester, aligned to evaluation-specific product, vertical, and geography requirements.
  • Lead the always-on Zoom Contact Center reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, treating reviews as a strategic content engine and maximizing AEO/GEO visibility while surfacing opportunities for intent lead generation, comparison reports, and managed services.
  • Collaborate with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, and Content teams to leverage customer reviews and market reports for demand generation, content enablement, and scaled advocacy impact.
  • Lead the CX Council end to end, managing member communications, meeting scheduling, agendas, and content preparation in partnership with the CX Council Executive Sponsor and key product leaders, while cultivating council members into long-term advocates across the full advocacy program.
  • Partner with Customer Success and GTM teams to continuously identify, develop, and maintain a pipeline of customer advocates whose stories, references, and participation support core Zoom Contact Center messaging pillars, product capabilities, and target verticals.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B high-tech marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in Customer Advocacy, Customer Marketing, or Content.
  • Demonstrated experience managing customer advocacy programs and third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to operate reviews as a strategic, always-on content engine.
  • Superb customer-facing communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to earn customer trust, request participation with professionalism and care, and steward long-term advocate relationships.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals, reporting on program performance, and using data to prioritize advocacy investments.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Analyst Relations teams, with a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.
  • Knowledge of or experience in the Contact Center, CCaaS, or CX technology market; familiarity with AEO/GEO concepts and how customer evidence contributes to AI-driven search visibility is a plus.

What You Can Expect

You will serve as the lead technical advocate for our customers, helping them understand and leverage Zoom's architectural advantages while partnering closely with our Upmarket Enterprise and Majors AE teams across the West. This is a role for a well-rounded, technically credible SE who brings broad knowledge across the full UCaaS stack, not just a single product line.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role supporting some of the most complex accounts in the country: enterprise-scale technology companies that demand sophisticated, multi-product solution design.

This role is for a forward-thinking UCaaS generalist with a passion for technology, a customer-first mindset, and a genuine drive to deliver happiness through transformative AI solutions.

About the Team

Supporting Upmarket West accounts, our Solutions Engineering team acts as the strategic and technical backbone for complex enterprise deal cycles. We partner closely with Account Executives to architect full-platform solutions, articulate Zoom’s competitive advantages, and deliver happiness to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Enterprise and Majors AEs to drive technical sales engagements across the full Zoom platform—including Meetings, Phone, Contact Center, Rooms, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, custom demos, and proofs of concept (POCs) tailored to address complex enterprise collaboration challenges.
  • Serve as the primary technical advocate for our clients, translating customer requirements into product recommendations and driving feature requests internally with Product and Engineering.

  • Strong working knowledge across the full UCaaS stack—SaaS collaboration, cloud voice, contact center, video, and unified communications—with ability to hit the ground running; generalist profile strongly preferred over narrow specialization.

This role is ideally based in Germany and fluent in German is required

Our Sales Operations team partners closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, and GTM Insights to keep Zoom's go-to-market engine running efficiently and intelligently. job.title: Program Manager, Customer Advocacy
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Program Manager, Customer Advocacy, you will lead Zoom's end-to-end customer reviews strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, building a sustainable, always-on program that transforms customer evidence into a strategic engine for market proof and competitive differentiation. This role sits at the intersection of customer advocacy, marketing strategy, and analyst relations, with direct responsibility for elevating the customer voice into AI visibility, marketing narratives, and sales enablement at scale. You will move Zoom's approach from episodic, award-driven solicitations to a strategic program that serves analyst evaluation cycles, supports AEO/GEO visibility, and feeds cross-functional marketing initiatives across content, demand generation, and social. For a strategist who is equally comfortable setting direction and executing in the details, this role offers the scope, visibility, and organizational impact to build something genuinely differentiated.


About the Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, shaping the stories, strategies, and digital experiences that connect Zoom's brand with its most important audiences. We own content strategy, editorial programs, customer advocacy, and the digital experience on zoom.com, working across Sales, Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, and Analyst Relations to turn customer evidence into a competitive advantage. We are a high-impact, cross-functional team that stays relentlessly focused on measurable outcomes and business impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end customer review strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, shifting from episodic award-driven solicitations to a strategic, always-on program that drives market proof and competitive differentiation.
  • Own the customer review calendar, balancing continuous review generation across key product categories with strategic alignment to analyst evaluation periods and market priorities.
  • Prioritize AEO/GEO visibility of customer reviews to maximize AI citations, support core marketing narratives, and influence technology buyer evaluations across the dark funnel.
  • Manage Zoom's presence across all subscribed and non-subscribed review platforms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strategic positioning while tracking volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Support key Analyst Relations market evaluations including Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with high-quality customer references, partnering with Product Marketing and AR to match references to specific product, industry, and geographic requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Content, Integrated Marketing, Social Media, and Digital teams to drive multi-channel promotion and consumption of customer reviews.
  • Partner with reviews vendors to shift relationships from tactical solicitation to a strategic content engine, leveraging comparison reports, customer story generation, and reference identification.
  • Surface growth opportunities by integrating customer reviews into internal AI search tools, identifying key strategic focus markets, and building organizational expertise across review platform capabilities including intent leads, content licensing, and emerging features.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B technology marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in customer advocacy, customer reviews management, or analyst relations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to track and analyze volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Superb customer-facing communication skills, with experience directing customer time and attention in ways that are respectful, strategic, and effective.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals and clearly reporting program performance to leadership.
  • Experience supporting analyst evaluations such as Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with customer references, and a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.
  • Familiarity with AEO/GEO concepts, customer advocacy platforms, and reference management tools; background in SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or enterprise technology marketing is a plus.

$76,800.00 - $186,200.00

job.title: Head of Infrastructure and Employee Services
job.description:
What you can expect​

Evaluate system performance, identify improvements, and implement innovative solutions to enhance functionality and user experience. Advance IT capabilities to increase productivity, safeguard intellectual property, and collaborate with Product Engineering to improve Zoom products. Oversee a team of approximately 70 individuals across seven global locations, managing strategy, planning, and delivery of IT infrastructure and end-user services. Responsibilities include end-user services, network solutions, technical support, security policy implementation, product testing, engineering infrastructure support, and vendor coordination. The ideal individual combines technical expertise with business insight, demonstrating excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills while effectively collaborating across teams in a dynamic environment.

About the Team

Zoom's Information Technology team is dedicated to delivering customer happiness, enhancing business efficiency, and fostering agility through innovation, data insights, and automation. Our impact is evident in seamless user experiences, streamlining processes, and supporting Zoom's growth in communication and collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a global team to oversee, operate, and support essential corporate IT services and product engineering labs, including Identity and Access Management (IAM). Managing EndPoint solutions, Unified Communications, Service operations, and multiple XaaS-based applications effectively.
  • Focusing on Infrastructure as Code while leveraging artificial intelligence and automating employee services to enhance efficiency and streamline processes effectively.
  • Identifying and driving strategic investments aimed at reducing technical debt effectively and efficiently.
  • Enabling Zoom-on-Zoom while collaborating with product teams to deliver essential input on feature gaps and product-related issues.
  • Analyzing business requirements to design and optimize system functionalities for improved operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Enhancing Zoom workforce productivity by creating and providing innovative workplace technologies and connectivity solutions for end users.
  • Establishing infrastructure portfolio governance and ensuring effective execution of cross-functionally prioritized initiatives outlined in the roadmap.
  • Maturing IT's role as Customer Zero for products, providing operator and end-user experience insights to support product development at Zoom.
  • Monitoring system performance and identifying opportunities for enhancements to maintain reliability and minimize downtime.

What we’re looking for:
Essential Requirements:

  • Hold qualifications in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or possess equivalent professional experience.
  • Bring 15 years of experience leading IT Infrastructure Technology and Operations, including 5 years in senior management at VP or Senior Director levels.
  • Manage extensive global IT teams within organizations exceeding 10,000 employees. Lead enterprise service support roles, overseeing multiple leaders in large-scale firms.
  • Demonstrate extensive expertise in planning, designing, and implementing scalable XaaS-based solutions and on-premise IT infrastructure with 24/7 global support services.
  • Demonstrate expertise in managing a worldwide IT infrastructure and support team using agile practices and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) methodology.
  • Demonstrate expertise in AI/ML, GenAI solutions, and their application in Service Desk or IT support environments.
  • Gain practical experience in aligning infrastructure and operations with frameworks such as NIST, SOX, SOC, and other industry standards.
  • Demonstrate expertise in technologies like Identity and Access Management (Okta, SailPoint), operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux), and Endpoint Management (Workspace One, Jamf, InTune, VDI). Utilize tools for Vulnerability Management (Qualys, Tenable), Unified Communications (Zoom, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, SendGrid), and Service Management (ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty). Apply security solutions (CrowdStrike, Digital Guardian) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service platforms (AWS, GCP).

job.title: Product Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

Zoom's AI products are growing fast - and we need someone equally fast to help fuel that growth. We're hiring a Product Growth Marketing Manager who thinks like a founder, moves like a creator, and lives at the intersection of AI and user obsession. You'll be marketing AI-powered products like ZoomMate, My Notes, Webinars, AI Productivity Suite, or Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) - which means you need to deeply understand how AI works, how people adopt it, and how to make cutting-edge technology feel approachable. This is not a "make the deck pretty" gig. This is a build-it, ship-it, measure-it, do-it-again kind of role - and we want someone who wouldn't have it any other way.


About the Team

Zoom is building a new AI-native way to work—helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables. As these products grow, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We're a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities

  • Running growth experiments from zero to results - you own the idea, the launch, the data, and the next move. No red tape, no waiting around.
  • Showing up where our users already are - TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, niche communities. You know the landscape because you live in it.
  • Creating content that people actually stop scrolling for - short-form video, social posts, blogs, threads, whatever format wins. You'll figure it out, then do more of it.
  • Partnering with Product, Engineering, and Design to turn product features into stories real people care about.
  • Leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter - you'll use generative AI, automation platforms, and AI-driven analytics to supercharge your workflow. If you're not already experimenting with AI in your day-to-day, this isn't the role for you.
  • Living in the data - funnel metrics, engagement rates, conversion signals. You'll know what's working, what's not, and you'll act on it fast.
  • Being the voice of the user in every room you walk into - bringing outside-in perspective to launches, campaigns, and strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • You have 1–5 years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, community building, content creation, or a related entrepreneurial hustle - with real, measurable results across social channels.
  • Startup DNA runs in your blood. You've worked at a small company, launched a side project, built something from nothing, freelanced your way through a problem - whatever it was, you operated like "creating a startup."
  • You have hands-on experience with AI-generated content, workflows, and analytics.
  • You're social-media native and understand how audiences, content formats, and distribution differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn—with demonstrated depth on multiple platforms.
  • You bias toward action. You ship fast, learn faster, and aren't afraid to fail in public. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity with minimal hand-holding.
  • You communicate with clarity and impact. Written, verbal, visual - you can make complex ideas simple and compelling.



Location: We are open to remote candidates in the US, or hybrid at our San Jose or Seattle offices.

$76,800.00 - $186,200.00
