job.title: Account Executive, Commercial, KSA
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for a strategic Account Executive to drive digital transformation within our Commercial sector. In this role, you will act as the business leader of your territory or accounts. Moving beyond simple transactional sales to orchestrate complex, multi-product solution selling. You will balance net-new customer acquisition with strategic expansion of our install base, leveraging the full platform (UCaaS, CCaaS, CX, AI) to solve critical business challenges.

About the Team

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Building and managing a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting across existing and new customer accounts to drive consistent revenue growth.

  • Orchestrating data-driven territory plans by leveraging insights and consumption trends to prioritize high-propensity accounts and optimize coverage.

  • Executing hybrid prospecting strategies that integrate social selling, partner co-selling, and direct outreach to uncover hidden opportunities within existing and new accounts.

  • Driving product consumption and adoption by identifying unused entitlements, converting them into active usage, and generating measurable business value.

  • Engaging C-Level, VP-Level, and functional decision-makers across Finance, HR, Operations, and Procurement to align solutions with strategic business goals and digital transformation roadmaps.

  • Negotiating complex, multi-horizon commercial agreements that include multi-year commitments and professional services to ensure long-term value and minimize churn.

  • Creating and delivering impactful presentations, proposals, and Quarterly Business Reviews that demonstrate ROI, benchmark performance, and outline future-state roadmaps aligned with customer objectives.

What we're looking for

  • Have proven Account Executive experience across UCaaS, CCaaS, and CX, with success in outbound prospecting, new logo acquisition, and push the status quo through tailored customer insights.

  • Demonstrate knowledge of Cloud Economics, including CAPEX vs. OPEX models, and build TCO and financial impact models to justify investments to financial stakeholders.

  • Use CRM systems and sales tools to manage pipeline development, forecasting, and deal progression with precision and accountability.

  • Maintain accurate commit forecasts and mutual action plans to ensure visibility, predictability, and alignment across all opportunities.

  • Exhibit resilience, adaptability, and a growth mindset while fostering collaboration, relationship-building, and effective communication across teams.

  • Show continuous learning and evolution of sales approaches to stay driven in changing markets and customer environments.

مدير حسابات، القطاع التجاري، الإمارات العربية المتحدة

ما يمكنك توقعه

تبحث Zoom عن مدير حسابات استراتيجي لدفع التحول الرقمي داخل قطاعنا التجاري في الإمارات العربية المتحدة. في هذا الدور، ستعمل كقائد أعمال لمنطقتك، والانتقال إلى ما هو أبعد من مبيعات المعاملات البسيطة لتنظيم بيع الحلول المعقدة والمتعددة المنتجات. ستقوم بموازنة اكتساب العملاء الجدد مع التوسع الاستراتيجي لقاعدة التثبيت الخاصة بنا، والاستفادة من النظام الأساسي الكامل ل Zoom (UCaaS و CCaaS و CX و AI) لحل تحديات الأعمال الحرجة.

حول الفريق

يعد فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة ديناميكية تقود نجاح الشركة. مع التركيز على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، يتفاعل الفريق بشغف مع العملاء في جميع أنحاء العالم. من خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يركز على العملاء، يلعبون دورًا محوريًا في توسيع الحضور العالمي ل Zoom وضمان تسخير الشركات للإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.

المسؤوليات

  • بناء وإدارة خط مبيعات قوي من خلال التنقيب الخارجي الاستباقي عبر حسابات العملاء الحالية والجديدة لدفع نمو الإيرادات المتسق

  • تنظيم خطط المناطق القائمة على البيانات من خلال الاستفادة من الرؤى واتجاهات الاستهلاك لتحديد أولويات الحسابات عالية الميل وتحسين التغطية

  • تنفيذ استراتيجيات التنقيب الهجينة التي تدمج البيع الاجتماعي والبيع المشترك للشركاء والتواصل المباشر للكشف عن الفرص داخل الحسابات الحالية والجديدة

  • تعزيز استهلاك المنتج واعتماده من خلال تحديد الاستحقاقات غير المستخدمة وتحويلها إلى استخدام نشط وتوليد قيمة تجارية قابلة للقياس

  • إشراك صانعي القرار من المستوى التنفيذي ومستوى نائب الرئيس والوظيفي عبر الشؤون المالية والموارد البشرية والعمليات والمشتريات لمواءمة الحلول مع أهداف الأعمال الاستراتيجية وخرائط طريق التحول الرقمي

  • التفاوض على اتفاقيات تجارية معقدة متعددة السنوات تتضمن خدمات احترافية لضمان القيمة طويلة الأجل وتقليل معدل التوقف

  • إنشاء وتقديم عروض تقديمية ومقترحات ومراجعات أعمال ربع سنوية مؤثرة توضح عائد الاستثمار والأداء المعياري وتحدد خرائط الطريق المستقبلية بما يتماشى مع أهداف العملاء

ما نبحث عنه

  • خبرة مثبتة كمدير حسابات في UCaaS و CCaaS و CX، مع نجاح موثق في التنقيب الخارجي واكتساب عملاء جدد ودفع التغيير من خلال رؤى العملاء المصممة خصيصًا

  • معرفة قوية باقتصاديات الحوسبة السحابية، بما في ذلك نماذج CAPEX مقابل OPEX، مع القدرة على بناء نماذج التكلفة الإجمالية للملكية والأثر المالي لتبرير الاستثمارات لأصحاب المصلحة الماليين

  • إتقان أنظمة CRM وأدوات المبيعات لإدارة تطوير خطوط الأنابيب والتنبؤ وتطور الصفقات بدقة ومساءلة

  • سجل حافل في الحفاظ على توقعات الالتزام الدقيقة وخطط العمل المتبادل لضمان الرؤية والقدرة على التنبؤ والمواءمة عبر جميع الفرص

  • المرونة والقدرة على التكيف وعقلية النمو مع مهارات قوية في التعاون وبناء العلاقات والتواصل بين الفرق

  • الالتزام بالتعلم المستمر وتطوير أساليب المبيعات للبقاء فعالاً في الأسواق المتغيرة وبيئات العملاء

job.description:
What You Can Expect

Zoom’s Enterprise Sales team is at the forefront of how the world’s largest organizations connect and collaborate. As Manager of Enterprise Sales in Tokyo, you will lead a team of account executives focused on enterprise clients across industry verticals, helping them unlock the full value of Zoom Workplace. You will own team performance and a portfolio of complex, high-value accounts, working alongside C-suite stakeholders to shape strategic deals that matter. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Tokyo, Japan office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

Our Enterprise Sales team in Japan partners with some of the region’s most influential organizations, guiding them through the full Zoom ecosystem. The team is structured by industry vertical, creating deep domain expertise and long-term client relationships built on trust. We work closely with technical resources, marketing, and global leadership to deliver outcomes that genuinely move the business forward.

Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue growth by meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual sales and product objectives across your team’s portfolio.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of account executives through strategic hiring, coaching, and performance management, partnering cross-functionally with recruitment to build team capability.
  • Manage account executive teams across Japan and additional markets as required.
  • Develop and deliver compelling client presentations, proposals, and Quarterly Business Reviews that clearly articulate Zoom’s value.
  • Engage C-level and VP-level executives in strategic conversations that address enterprise business needs and unlock new opportunities.
  • Apply solution-selling methodologies to guide complex sales cycles to close, growing revenue within existing accounts and new enterprise relationships.

  • Resolve client escalations thoroughly and efficiently, maintaining high satisfaction across the enterprise portfolio.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape, product developments, and industry trends to keep the team informed and positioned to win.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience managing large enterprise accounts, and at least 5 years managing a team.
  • Direct SaaS or cloud solutions selling experience; video or web conferencing background strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, with strong pipeline management and business forecasting skills.

job.title: Marketing Data Operations Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As our Marketing Data Operations Analyst, you will serve as both a technical expert and an advisory partner to EMEA marketing stakeholders, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter campaign and strategic decisions. You will own the segmentation, database management, and data quality frameworks that power Zoom's marketing database, working closely with the wider Marketing Operations team, IT, and Data teams. This role sits within the Digital Transformation Office, giving you visibility across how data strategy connects to enterprise marketing outcomes at scale. This role requires working hours aligned to EMEA markets, with a shift of 12:30 PM to 8:30 PM IST.


About the Team

The Marketing Data Operations team is part of the wider Marketing Operations team within Zoom's Digital Transformation Office and is responsible for the infrastructure, processes, and operational frameworks that power our marketing database. We enable data accessibility, quality, and operational execution for Enterprise Marketing, ensuring that marketing teams have reliable, actionable data to inform campaigns and strategic decisions. We are a collaborative team working across Marketing Operations, IT, and Data functions to keep Zoom's marketing database accurate, current, and strategically aligned.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze audience and database performance metrics, surfacing key trends, patterns, and actionable insights that inform EMEA marketing strategy and decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver recurring insight outputs including audience health readouts, engagement trend analyses, and segmentation performance summaries for marketing stakeholders.
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and systemic issues in current processes, segmentation logic, and data quality, leading continuous improvement initiatives without waiting for escalation.
  • Create, manage, and evolve audience segments and segmentation models aligned to EMEA regional objectives, translating marketing requirements into effective audience builds grounded in business context.
  • Own compliance with privacy regulations including GDPR and internal opt-in requirements for new and existing data within the marketing database.
  • Collaborate with Data Operations, Marketing Operations, and cross-functional IT and Data teams to ensure the marketing database remains accurate, current, and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Build and maintain proactive relationships with EMEA marketing stakeholders, delivering enablement sessions that improve their understanding and utilization of Zoom's marketing database.
  • Communicate complex data concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders, providing data-driven context that explains what the data means and what actions it suggests.


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in a technology, data, or business-related field, or equivalent experience, with 8 or more years of experience working with large-scale B2B or B2C marketing databases.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing data ecosystems including CRM systems (Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), CDP platforms (Data Cloud), data warehouses (Snowflake), and BI tools (Tableau).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries for segmentation, analysis, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into business-facing insights, articulating not just what the data shows but what it means for marketing stakeholders and what actions it might inform.
  • Proven ability to own and deliver projects independently from scoping to completion, managing timelines and stakeholder expectations without constant oversight.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset that identifies issues before they are reported, brings solutions alongside diagnosis, and drives improvement without waiting for direction.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non-technical audiences clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, combined with strong attention to detail and a quality-first approach.

job.title: Physical Security Technology and Operations Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role sits at the intersection of physical security technology and operational resilience, giving you the opportunity to shape and advance Zoom's global security infrastructure across offices and data centers worldwide. The work spans cloud-native video management, enterprise access control, AI-assisted monitoring, and automation platforms, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep Zoom's people, facilities, and operations safe and secure. Expect real breadth: from leading technology design and deployment to supporting 24/7 business continuity, this position rewards both technical depth and collaborative problem-solving. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 4 days per week at our London, England office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Global Physical Security and Safety team protects Zoom's people, assets, and operations across a worldwide portfolio of offices and data centers. Partnering closely with Workplace, Business Resilience, EHS, IT, and external vendors, the team delivers integrated security solutions built to scale with Zoom's growth. This London-based role serves as a key regional presence within a globally connected team, reporting to the Senior Manager of Global Physical Security and Safety.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with the physical security team, cross-functional counterparts (Workplace, Business Resilience, EHS, IT), and external partners on all physical security technology and design matters impacting people, facilities, and processes.
  • Advise on and guide security planning for new office design, expansions, conversions, and restructuring, serving as the liaison between Workplace, Physical Security, Business Resilience, and EHS to promote change management and ensure compliance with standards.
  • Design and propose integrated physical security solutions for deterrence, delay, detection, and response to threats, leading design reviews with key stakeholders to ensure protection-in-depth across all Zoom locations.
  • Prepare RFPs with technical requirements and cost estimates, lead bid reviews with stakeholders, support procurement and contracting, and provide quality assurance on bills of materials for security integrators.
  • Lead installation and acceptance testing phases for physical security system upgrades and new deployments, coordinating closely with vendors and key stakeholders throughout.
  • Own the full lifecycle of physical security system assets, including SOP development, periodic testing and auditing, maintenance, troubleshooting of system and network issues, and annual training delivery.
  • Manage the physical security systems budget across Zoom locations, and contribute to ongoing research, policy review, and technology recommendations that strengthen Zoom's security posture.
  • Provide operational support to the physical security team, maintaining 24/7 business resilience across Zoom's worldwide office and data center portfolio, with flexibility to support global sites across time zones.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in physical security for a private sector multinational company, including management of security technology projects, scope, budget, and third-party contracts.
  • Demonstrated expertise in physical security technology controls, including Automated Access Control Systems (AACS), CCTV, intrusion detection, and alarm systems, with experience leading design and implementation projects.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability and threat assessments, incident management, site assessments, and general security operations in enterprise or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating across cross-functional teams including IT, Workplace, Facilities, and external vendors.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Asana, and Adobe, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation including SOPs, RFPs, and BOMs.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP) and/or Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience, with the ability to travel globally to Zoom office and data center locations.


Ways of Working

job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, you'll sit at the center of Zoom's Go-To-Market and Revenue Operations function, where your work shapes how we scale a compliant, data-driven revenue engine globally. You'll partner closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, and IT to design processes that are both rigorous and adaptable, bringing clarity to complex cross-functional challenges. This role offers real ownership across the full Demand-to-Retention lifecycle, from pipeline strategy to CPQ and renewals, giving you the breadth to grow as a systems and process leader. You'll operate as a trusted voice in strategic conversations, translating business needs into scalable solutions that directly impact how Zoom goes to market.


About the Team

Our Go-To-Market and Revenue Operations team sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Operations, and IT to build a scalable and compliant revenue engine. We are focused on process excellence and systems strategy, enabling smarter Go-To-Market growth and more efficient revenue management across the business.

  • Own and optimize end-to-end Demand-to-Retention (D2R) processes across lead generation, opportunity conversion, pipeline management, forecasting, CPQ/quote-to-cash, renewals, and expansion

job.description:
What you can expect

The Channel Account Manager enhances sales revenue by building relationships with partners in Saudi Arabia They collaborate with partners on marketing plans, training, and needs. They drive growth through channel programs and align with objectives while maintaining customer satisfaction.


About the Team

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.
 

What we’re looking for

  • Have 2+ years experience in managing partnerships in Unified Communications/ Cloud /Telephony space.
  • Be able to develop and execute sales strategies for Partner programs & sales enablement
  • Experience with SaaS Resellers in Saudi Arabia; fluent Arabic speaker required
  • Have a deep understanding of the Partner ecosystem
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills to effectively collaborate with partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Be proficient in analyzing sales data and market trends to identify opportunities for growth with Channel partners
  • Have collaborated with the Alliances that drive the Zoom ecosystem. i.e Poly, Dten, NEAT, Oracle, Ribbon, Jabra, Verint.




ما يُمكن توقعه
يُعزز مدير حسابات القنوات إيرادات المبيعات من خلال بناء علاقات متينة مع الشركاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. ويتعاون مع الشركاء في وضع خطط التسويق والتدريب وتلبية احتياجاتهم. كما يُساهم في دفع عجلة النمو من خلال برامج القنوات، ويتوافق مع الأهداف مع الحفاظ على رضا العملاء.


نبذة عن الفريق
يُمثل فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة دافعة لنجاح الشركة. ويركز الفريق على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، ويتفاعل بحماس مع العملاء حول العالم. ومن خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يضع العميل في صميم اهتمامه، يلعب الفريق دورًا محوريًا في توسيع نطاق حضور Zoom العالمي، وضمان استفادة الشركات من الإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.


ما نبحث عنه

  • امتلاك خبرة من 5 إلى 7 سنوات في إدارة الشراكات في مجال الاتصالات الموحدة / الحوسبة السحابية / الهاتف.
  • القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات لبرامج الشركاء وتمكين المبيعات
  • خبرة في التعامل مع موزعي البرامج كخدمة (SaaS) في المملكة العربية السعودية، مع اشتراط إتقان اللغة العربية تحدثاً وكتابة.
  • امتلاك فهم عميق لنظام الشركاء البيئي
  • امتلاك مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة للتعاون بفعالية مع الشركاء وأصحاب المصلحة الداخليين.
  • الكفاءة في تحليل بيانات المبيعات واتجاهات السوق لتحديد فرص النمو مع شركاء القنوات
  • التعاون مع التحالفات التي تدفع نظام Zoom البيئي، مثل Poly و Dten و NEAT و Oracle و Ribbon و Jabra و Verint.

As an SMB Account Executive in Tokyo, you will own a growing portfolio of small business clients across Japan, guiding organizations with up to 50 employees toward Zoom Workplace solutions that fit how they work. You will bring a consultative approach to every client conversation, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to build the kind of trust that turns first engagements into long-term relationships. This is a front-line role with direct visibility into Zoom’s Japan go-to-market strategy, offering meaningful scope and a clear path to grow your career alongside our business. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Tokyo office.

About the Team

Our Japan sales team is a dedicated group focused on bringing Zoom’s communications solutions to businesses across the country. We operate with a customer-first mindset, building strategic partnerships that help clients unlock the full value of virtual collaboration. Every team member plays a meaningful part in expanding Zoom’s presence in the Japanese market.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of consultative selling and cloud communications, helping UK&I organisations move beyond legacy telephony to an intelligent, AI-first experience with Zoom Phone. You will partner closely with Account Executives and channel partners to drive net-new and upsell opportunities across the Mid-Market and Enterprise segments, supporting the full sales cycle from discovery through to close. The Zoom Phone sales team sits at the heart of Zoom Workplace, helping organisations replace legacy telephony with a cloud-native, AI-first communications platform. Our mission is to grow Zoom’s presence across UK&I by demonstrating that modern telephony is about unlocking the intelligence within every conversation.

job.title: Workplace Coordinator, Customer Engagement
job.description:
Workplace Coordinator, Customer Engagement

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will serve as the face of Zoom’s Tokyo office, creating meaningful experiences for customers, employees, and visitors at one of our most important customer-facing sites in the region. You will lead day-to-day operations while supporting high-impact customer events and Experience Center programming, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Zoom’s standard for world-class service. Beyond office management, you will play an active part in the planning and execution of Zoom’s new Tokyo office relocation, collaborating with contractors, internal stakeholders, and a global Real Estate and Workplace Services team spanning markets from Singapore to San Jose. Full professional fluency in Japanese and English is required for this role. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our Tokyo, Japan office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Real Estate and Workplace Services team at Zoom drives the physical environments and workplace experiences that enable Zoom’s global workforce to do their best work. Operating across major offices in the Asia Pacific region and beyond, this team ensures every Zoom location is a welcoming, functional, and connected space for Zoomies and customers alike. As a member of the Tokyo team, you will contribute to a growing APAC presence with close ties to counterparts in Singapore, Sydney, Mumbai, and the broader global organization.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the Tokyo office end-to-end, managing facilities, vendor relationships, preventative maintenance, badge access, shipping and receiving, and catering coordination to maintain a safe, welcoming environment for all employees and guests.
  • Lead on-site health and safety protocols, including emergency procedures and evacuation planning, as an active member of Zoom’s local health and safety team.
  • Deliver exceptional customer and visitor experiences by welcoming guests, pre-registering attendees, and serving as the primary on-site point of contact during all customer visits and Experience Center events.
  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of customer-facing and internal events, covering room setup, AV readiness, catering logistics, and post-event wrap-up.
  • Manage virtual reception across the APAC region and collaborate with regional Workplace Coordinators in Singapore, Sydney, and Mumbai to align on standards, share best practices, and support cross-regional initiatives.
  • Coordinate Zoom’s Tokyo office relocation by serving as the on-the-ground liaison for construction and fit-out activities, tracking milestones, flagging issues, managing FF&E procurement, and supporting Day 1 readiness planning.
  • Partner with administrative and onboarding teams to support new hire workspace setup, badge issuance, office orientation, vendor contract records, purchase order tracking, and budget reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2 or more years of experience in workplace coordination, office management, facilities, events, or an executive briefing or customer engagement environment, with a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality employee and customer experiences.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating customer-facing events, VIP visits, or executive programming, with strong attention to logistics, setup, and real-time problem-solving.
  • Stakeholder and vendor management experience, including familiarity with preventative maintenance processes and health and safety protocols.
  • Experience with internal facility ticketing systems and a proven ability to manage workloads within established SLAs; office relocation or build-out experience is a plus.
  • Organized, self-directed approach to work with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive projects to completion with minimal direction.
  • Full professional fluency in Japanese and English (written and spoken) is required.
  • Proficiency in workplace tools including the Zoom Workplace platform, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and facility management systems.

job.title: Audio AI Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

As an Audio AI Engineer, you will research and develop algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and speech recognition on low-latency streaming architectures. You’ll prototype and refine end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while maintaining speaker identity. Working closely with product and platform teams, you’ll help bring these models into real-time communication systems. You will also evaluate and optimize model performance across dimensions such as quality, latency, and scalability. Staying current with advances in speech processing, you’ll contribute to innovation through patents and internal knowledge sharing.

About the Team

Zoom's Audio team develops real-time audio features based on AI algorithms. Members of the team are spread worldwide, including the U.S., China and Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Researching, designing, and developing algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and automatic speech recognition, focusing on low-latency streaming architectures.

  • Prototyping end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while preserving speaker identity and expressiveness.

  • Collaborating closely with product and platform teams to integrate models into real-time video and audio communication systems.

  • Analyzing and optimizing model performance across speech quality, latency, robustness, and scalability dimensions.

  • Staying current with the latest developments in speech processing research, and contribute to the community through patents, and internal knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Hold a PhD or equivalent experience in a relevant field in Streaming, Accent Conversion, Voice Conversion, TTS, or ASR. More than 2 years of relevant industry experience considered a plus.

  • Show proficiency in deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Demonstrate effective programming skills in Python, C/C++, or similar languages.

  • Have an understanding of sequence modeling architectures (Transformers, RNNs, diffusion models, or conformers).

  • Demonstrate experience developing and deploying low-latency, real-time speech or audio models with streaming architectures and optimized pipelines.

  • Show familiarity with model compression and acceleration techniques, including quantization, pruning, and distillation.

  • Exhibit experience working with real-time audio systems in networked communication environments.

  • Publish in top-tier conferences such as Icassp, Interspeech, NeurIPS, and ICLR.

job.description:
Zoom Onboarding Specialist

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own the end-to-end onboarding experience for newly contracted customers in Japan, guiding them from kickoff through to a confident handoff to the Customer Success team. You will deliver live administrator and end-user training sessions independently, working directly with customers to drive successful adoption of Zoom Workplace, Zoom Phone, and Zoom Revenue Accelerator. Native-level Japanese fluency and the ability to create and localize training materials from English source content are required for this role. You will report to the US-based Zoom Onboarding Specialist (ZOS) manager and serve as the primary Japan market voice, sharing customer insights and shaping local onboarding processes.

About the Team

The Zoom Onboarding Specialist team sits within the Customer Success organization and plays a meaningful role in how customers experience Zoom from day one. We partner closely with CSMs, CSAs, Sales, and Renewals teams across Japan and globally to ensure every customer gets the foundation they need to grow and thrive. Our work directly influences product adoption, customer retention, and the long-term success of Zoom’s enterprise relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver live customer training sessions, including administrator training, end-user training, and power-pack sessions, independently and with confidence.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for newly contracted accounts: kickoff coordination, configuration guidance, training delivery, and handoff to CSM/CSA.
  • Create and localize training materials by translating and adapting global English-language resources, including slide decks, guides, and FAQs, into Japanese.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CSM, CSA, Renewals, and Sales teams in Japan to ensure seamless customer handoffs and aligned onboarding strategies.
  • Analyze customer onboarding trends and provide actionable feedback to internal stakeholders to uphold quality standards and address evolving product and customer requirements.

job.description:

In this role, you will serve as the technical anchor of every pre-sales engagement across APJ, partnering with Account Executives, Customer Experience teams, and Channel Partners to translate complex enterprise requirements into compelling, tailored Workvivo solutions. You will lead consultative discovery sessions, deliver persona-based product demonstrations, and drive technical wins across Workvivo's full portfolio spanning Workvivo HQ, HQ Agent, Seer, Chat, Workvivo TV, and our integrations ecosystem. Fluency in both English and Japanese is essential: you will lead customer-facing engagements, executive briefings, and technical workshops in either language across a diverse region that includes Japan, Singapore, Australia, India, and Southeast Asia. You will report to the Regional Sales Leader in APJ, with a dotted line to the Global Head of Solutions. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Singapore office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Workvivo Solutions Engineering team is a high-performing, globally connected group that sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer success, directly influencing deal outcomes and product direction across some of the world's largest employers. In APJ, one of Workvivo's fastest-growing markets, we are redefining how enterprises communicate, listen, and act through AI-native products like Workvivo HQ and Seer. Our team achieved a 97% engagement score and exceeded revenue targets at 106% last quarter, and we are building on that momentum together.

Responsibilities

  • Lead consultative discovery sessions that uncover customer goals, pain points, existing technology stacks, and success metrics, and translate findings into proposed Workvivo solutions tied to measurable business outcomes.

  • Design and deliver tailored, persona-based product demonstrations across Workvivo HQ, HQ Agent, Seer, Chat, Workvivo TV, and Advanced Analytics, connecting platform capabilities to the priorities of CHRO, CPO, CIO, and Head of Internal Communications stakeholders.

  • Own the Solutions Engineering motion across APJ, managing active opportunities end-to-end through qualification, technical validation, proof-of-concept, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, and commercial close via Salesforce.

  • Serve as the primary SE for Japanese-language opportunities, leading discovery, demonstrations, and technical conversations in Japanese with full fluency.

  • Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap priorities through structured feature requests and customer feedback, with particular focus on localisation and APJ-specific requirements.

  • Enable and support Channel Partners and generalist SEs across APJ with Workvivo product knowledge, demo best practices, and competitive positioning.

  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Onboarding teams to ensure seamless deal handovers and contribute to expansion opportunities across Seer, HQ Agent, and Advanced Analytics.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within a SaaS organisation or the technology industry, or equivalent experience.

  • Fluency in both English and Japanese, written and spoken, with demonstrated ability to lead customer-facing engagements, technical workshops, and executive presentations in either language.

  • Proven track record supporting complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with contributions to six-figure-plus ARR deal closures.

  • Strong technical acumen across APIs, integrations, SSO/SAML, HRIS data flows, enterprise search, and AI/ML concepts, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, translating complex platform capabilities into compelling business narratives tailored to senior executive personas.

  • Self-starter who operates with autonomy across a geographically dispersed region, managing competing priorities and multiple deal cycles simultaneously, with willingness to travel within APJ approximately 20-30% of the time.

  • Ability to conduct compelling demonstrations that showcase the strengths of SaaS products to both channel partners and end users


職務概要

私たちは、新たなパートナー営業をZoom Japanに迎えたいと考えています。このポジションでは、日本におけるパートナーエコシステムの構築、醸成、そして収益成長の推進を担当していただきます。この役割は戦略的なイネーブルメントの専門知識と収益成長の責任を組み合わせ、パートナー企業とともに測定可能なビジネス成果を提供します。一般的なパートナールート営業ではなく、パートナーとの新規案件の創出も積極的に行うポジションです。東京を拠点とし、日本のチャネル責任者に報告します。

チームについて

ダイナミックなZoomセールスチームは、最先端のコミュニケーションソリューションを世界中に提供することで会社の成功を推進しています。戦略的パートナーシップと顧客中心のアプローチを通じて、グローバルなプレゼンスを拡大し、企業がバーチャルコラボレーションを活用できるよう支援しています。


主な職務内容

  • パートナーの販売パフォーマンスを直接向上させる包括的なイネーブルメントプログラムの設計と実施
  • 単なる関係維持ではなく、収益加速のためのパートナー能力開発
  • 収益目標に沿ったパートナーとの四半期ビジネスプランの作成と実行
  • パートナーパフォーマンスデータの分析と結果改善のための変更実施
  • 技術的ガイダンスの提供と収益目標に対するパートナーの責任管理のバランス
  • Zoom Japanのパートナーエコシステムにおける測定可能なビジネス成果の推進

求める人材

  • Tech企業での5年以上の営業経験（パートナーイネーブルメントとパフォーマンス最適化のご経験をお持ちの方）
  • 収益成長につながるパートナーのビジネス開発経験
  • 構造化されたイネーブルメント手法とパフォーマンス分析の経験
  • データ駆動型の意思決定と分析的思考スキル
  • 流暢な日本語スキル（このポジションは東京勤務です）
  • 英語スキル（文書、読解）*会話できる方歓迎
  • 日本市場におけるチャネルビジネスの経験
  • 急速に変化する環境への柔軟性と俊敏な学習能力
  • チャネルパートナーとエンドユーザーの両方にSaaS製品の強みを示す説得力のあるデモンストレーション能力

なぜZoomのチャネルチームでのキャリアが面白い？

このポジションは、日本のパートナーエコシステムにおける成長の触媒となるユニークな機会を提供します。優れた関係構築とパフォーマンス責任のバランスを取りながら、パートナーの能力を開発し、測定可能なビジネス成果を推進します。イネーブルメントと収益達成の両方に優れている方からのご応募をお待ちしています。
